raw.description:
Duties

Functional

  • Coordinate IT operations with the service providers to ensure delivery of timely and effective IT services that operate at a high level of stability and efficiency.

  • Work with the IT service provider to optimize and improve local company networks and servers.

  • Manage installations and upgrades of IT systems at Sensia facilities in close coordination with Global Real Estate Project Manager.

  • Be the single point of contact for IT escalations.

  • Ensure issues are resolved in a timely manner by the service provider.

  • Provide support and guidance to Sensia employees globally.

  • Oversee end user device inventory, replacement and delivery to users.

  • Oversee the management, procurement and licensing of computer software applications driving common standards and best practises.

  • Develop and coordinate manufacturing OT practises in coordination with parent company experience.

  • Ensure backup of information and data to ensure recovery in event of system breakdown.

  • Establish periodic operations reviews and reports.

  • Reasonably challenge established standards to ensure that the correct technology is being applied for the best interests of Sensia.

  • Be able to evaluate new technologies to advance deliverables.

  • Excellent analytical skills & attention to detail.

  • Develop and execute regular IT operations review with service.

Leadership

  • Execute technical and interpersonal skills.

  • Develop and evolve Sensia specific IT policies and practices in coordination with Sensia Cyber Security Office.

  • Effectively resolve conflict service provider to meet business goals.

  • Independently identify, manage and mitigate risks, resulting in proactive contingency planning as required.

  • Persevere through obstacles to achieve results and remove obstacles to facilitate Sensia success.

  • Demonstrate confidence, maturity and flexibility in response to work challenges.

  • Self-directed leader with ability to work with cross functional/global teams.

  • Provide early and clear escalation of critical issues.

  • Clear effective communication across all levels of the organization.

  • Ability to integrate business needs with corporate policies and industry best practice.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven operation management experience.

  • Problem-solving aptitude.

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, IT, or other relevant field.

  • Willingness to travel globally as required.

Desired Qualifications:

  • IT Leadership experience.

  • Experience managing out-sourced IT / other operations.

  • Experience with system installation, configuration and analysis.

  • Power Platform knowledge and experience in technologies like Power BI, Power Apps and Power Automate is desirable.

  • Microsoft Azure and Office 365 certifications or proven experience.

  • Knowledge of data protection operations and legislation (e.g. GDPR).

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Sensia is looking for a highly organized operations professional to provide effective leadership, strategy and coordination of the IT services provided for Sensia by its service providers. This position is a key role in the company's efforts to drive efficiencies for its employees, enhance the end-user experience and drive the “start-up” / small agile company culture.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the oversight of all day-to-day IT operations for Sensia and work closely with the service providers to deploy continuous improvements as Sensia evolves and grows.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to the job. They are not intended to be an all-encompassing list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Reasonable accommodations to essential functions of the job will be made if necessary.

raw.description:
Company: US-based Sweepstakes Casino

Employment Type: Full-Time (Contractor)

Work Setup: Fully Remote

Working Schedule: Day Shift (PHT), aligned with US business needs

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced CRM Manager to own and scale our customer lifecycle strategy for a fast-growing US sweepstakes casino. This role is responsible for driving player engagement, retention, reactivation, and lifetime value through data-driven CRM initiatives while ensuring full compliance with US sweepstakes regulations.

The role will work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, BI, and Compliance teams to deliver personalized, timely, and responsible player communications across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Strategy & Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end CRM strategy across the player lifecycle: onboarding, engagement, retention, reactivation, and churn prevention
  • Design and optimize player journeys based on behavior, value, and engagement patterns
  • Segment players using transactional and behavioral data (e.g., activity, recency, frequency, value)

Campaign Planning & Execution

  • Plan, execute, and optimize CRM campaigns across email, push notifications, SMS, and in-app messaging
  • Manage promotional campaigns, including bonuses, free entries, tournaments, and retention mechanics aligned with sweepstakes rules
  • Ensure campaigns are timely, relevant, and personalized

Data, Analytics & Optimization

  • Track and analyze CRM KPIs such as retention, conversion, reactivation, ARPU/LTV, and churn
  • Conduct A/B testing on messaging, timing, offers, and journeys
  • Translate insights into actionable improvements and clear performance reporting

Compliance & Responsible Play

  • Ensure all CRM communications comply with US sweepstakes regulations, internal policies, and responsible play standards
  • Maintain opt-in, opt-out, and communication preference best practices

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with Product and UX teams to improve in-app experiences and messaging triggers
  • Collaborate with the BI team on dashboards, segmentation logic, and campaign attribution
  • Coordinate with Marketing and Creative teams on campaigns, creatives, and promotional calendars

Tools & CRM Platforms

  • Drive CRM strategy through hands-on ownership of Optimove, using player segmentation, value modeling, and automated lifecycle campaigns to improve retention, increase ARPU, and grow long-term player value
  • Maintain CRM workflows, automation, and campaign calendar
  • Support data hygiene and CRM best practices

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing experience within real-money online gaming, sweepstakes casinos, social casinos, or comparable high-engagement digital products
  • Strong understanding of the US player market, including customer behavior, motivations, promotional sensitivity, and lifecycle expectations
  • Native or near-native English proficiency, with the ability to craft compelling, compliant, and conversion-focused messaging
  • Proven track record of delivering measurable CRM impact, including:

- End-to-end customer journey design and optimization

- Promotional strategy and execution

- Player segmentation and personalization

- High-performing email and multi-channel CRM campaigns

  • Exceptional communication skills, able to clearly articulate strategy, present insights, and collaborate effectively with key stakeholders
  • Highly analytical mindset, with strong experience in performance tracking, reporting, and translating data into actionable insights
  • Proven hands-on expertise in Optimove, with the ability to independently build segments, configure multi-step lifecycle journeys, manage triggers, execute A/B tests, and analyze campaign performance
  • Working knowledge of HTML and experience with automated CRM platforms (e.g., Optimove, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar) is a strong advantage
  • Experience designing or managing loyalty and VIP programs is a plus

About Us

10Ten Gaming is a fast-growing US-based sweepstakes casino building the next generation of social casino experiences.

Founded by industry veterans, we combine high-energy gameplay, cutting-edge technology, and a player-first mindset to create fun, fair, and compliant casino-style games powered by Sweeps Coins and Gold Coins. We move fast, experiment often, and give our teams real ownership to make a meaningful impact from day one.

If you’re excited by high-growth startups, autonomy, and shaping products used by thousands of players, 10Ten Gaming is the place to build and scale something special.

Come build the future of social gaming with us!

Due to increasing demand from our school and program partners, iTutor is seeking New York State Certified Special Education Teachers (K-12) to deliver one-to-one, small group, and whole class instruction virtually using our proprietary technology platform.

Our NYS State-Certified Special Education teachers will work remotely through instructional programs with assigned students. Educators will communicate regularly with students to ensure they successfully complete their instructional programs and will be responsible for completion of the following tasks:

  • Support the instructional program with live video, audio and chat synchronous instruction to small groups of students
  • Conduct formative assessments and devise and implement appropriate supplemental instruction that is differentiated to the student’s needs
  • Complete all grading by providing prompt, high-quality, personalized feedback on assignments;
  • Proctor online testing each semester to ensure appropriate integrity of test results
  • Consult with team members and administrators to develop alternate enrichment activities and lesson modifications to increase student understanding and promote success for struggling or at-risk students through differentiation
  • Develop a detailed knowledge of the assigned curriculum used in the school by participating in professional development workshops and training
  • Communicate regularly with students using Chat features of the LMS and our internal messaging system
  • Create a welcoming and engaging online learning experience for the students (and parents as appropriate) through the use of a warm online voice and demeanor that is inviting and supportive towards students and families.

This is a work-from-home position.

Qualifications:

  • Must presently hold an active Special Education teaching certification in New York State
  • Must have a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college/university in the United States
  • Must have a laptop or desktop computer, webcam and headset, as well as reliable internet access
  • Prior online teaching experience a plus!

raw.title: Manager - Data Engineering
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a highly motivated Manager - Data Engineering to join our growing team.
raw.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Manager - Data Engineering to join our growing team. This role will report to the Director of Data Engineering and will lead a team of data engineers. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with a passion for mentoring others and delivering scalable, high-quality data solutions. You will collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, technology teams, and business leaders to design and implement robust data pipelines and platforms that support internal and external clients. With over a million managed lives across the country and terabytes of healthcare data generated, your leadership will be critical to empowering our organization with the tools and insights needed to drive innovation and improve patient outcomes.

Our Values:
  • Put Patients First
  • Empower Entrepreneurial Provider and Care Teams
  • Operate with Integrity & Excellence
  • Be Innovative
  • Work As One Team

What You'll Do

  • Lead and mentor a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to design and implement scalable data pipelines and models aligned with business needs and industry best practices.
  • Oversee the development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade ELT processes, data marts, and business intelligence assets.
  • Own and evolve data quality frameworks, ensuring proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolution of data issues.
  • Champion the adoption of automation and modern data engineering practices, driving efficiencies in pipeline management and data delivery.
  • Guide your team in building domain knowledge around healthcare operations, ensuring data solutions comply with regulatory and security requirements.
  • Contribute to strategic planning for the data engineering function, including resource allocation, technology selection, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Support and enforce software development best practices, including code reviews, source control, CI/CD, and testing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required in computer science, engineering, healthcare, analytics, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • At least 5 years of experience in data engineering or software development roles, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or management capacity.
  • At least 2 years of experience with medical claims in healthcare and/or managed care.
  • Strong expertise in building scalable ELT/ETL pipelines using modern data platforms and cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Advanced proficiency with SQL and scripting/programming languages such as Python or Spark.
  • Solid understanding of database structures, data modeling (normalized, star schema, snowflake), and data warehousing concepts.
  • Experience working with Databricks or similar distributed computing platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with BI tools such Power BI.
  • Deep understanding of professional software engineering practices including SDLC, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
You're a great fit for this role if you:
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy leading teams to solve complex data challenges.
  • Are passionate about mentoring and growing the next generation of data engineering talent.
  • Have a bias for action and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions with measurable impact.
  • Bring a collaborative, team-first mindset to everything you do.

Environmental Job Requirements and Working Conditions

  • This position is remotely based in the U.S.
  • The total compensation target pay range for this role is: $140,000 - $160,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location (current or future), experience, and other job-related factors.
Astrana Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need. If you require assistance in applying for open positions due to a disability, please email us at to request an accommodation.

我们是全球最早也是最成熟的数字资产平台之一，服务于全球数千万用户。我们始终位列全球顶级交易所之列，提供涵盖数千种数字资产的全面交易和财富管理产品。
我们拥有遍布全球主要金融中心的数千名员工，秉持远程优先、高度自主的企业文化，吸引着那些在快节奏、高挑战性环境中如鱼得水的优秀人才。我们正在构建下一代互联网的金融基础设施——我们正在寻找杰出的专业人士加入我们，共同塑造这一未来。

关于这个方向
这块业务覆盖合约跟单、CFD 跟单、美股实盘跟单，以及现货网格、马丁策略、期限套利等机器人业务，同时正在探索 AI 对话策略方向。这不是一个维护功能列表的岗位。我们需要一个真正理解交易行为、能在产品复杂度和用户理解之间找到平衡点的人。

你会负责什么
1、深入研究新手、进阶、和专业用户如何在跟单、机器人和自建策略之间做选择，并将洞察转化为产品决策
2、与工程、量化研究、AI、风控、设计、运营等团队协同，澄清需求取舍，持续推动产品高质量上线
3、持续追踪跟单交易、量化工具和 AI 投资类产品的前沿动态，形成自己的判断，而不是机械复制功能
4、围绕量化策略方向，推动经典机器人策略优化、策略参数可理解性设计、AI 策略探索、策略表现与归因展示等功能落地
5、围绕跟单交易方向，优化交易员发现与信任体系、跟单配置与风控体验、多品类跟单建设、仓位透明度与信任信号设计

我们希望你具备
1、对交易行为和金融产品有真实兴趣，进入复杂领域时能快速找到核心逻辑，而不是停留在表面功能
2、有较强的独立驱动力；需求不清晰时，你会主动定义目标、厘清路径，而不是等待被推动
3、能理解风险决策场景下的用户心理：为什么用户会选择某个交易员、中途关掉机器人、调整参数或彻底失去信任
4、有清晰的产品判断力：一个跟单界面或策略配置页面有没有把复杂信息讲清楚、风险展示是否会造成误导，你能看出来
5、具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能在技术、量化研究、风控和业务之间建立共识，而不只是在中间传话

加分项
1、有跟单交易、社交交易（Social Trading）、交易机器人或量化平台类产品的完整项目经验

2、对跟单或量化策略其中一个方向的交易工具有浓厚兴趣，是主流平台产品的重度用户

3、有 AI 产品方向的思考或经验，理解自然语言交互如何与专业金融工具结合

4、有用户研究、数据分析或 A/B 实验经验，能将行为数据转化为产品洞察

raw.description:
dein aufgabengebiet

  • Einarbeitung, Aufbau und Entwicklung relevanter Social Content Kompetenzen im Rahmen unseres 18-monatigen Trainee-Programms mit einem klar definierten Ziel: Übernahme in eine Festanstellung
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Social-First-Videoformaten insbesondere Schnitt und Postproduktion für Kundenprojekte
  • Begleitung von Drehs und Unterstützung bei operativen Aufgaben vor Ort (Deutschlandweit)
  • Mitarbeit in DaVinci Resolve und der Adobe Creative Cloud sowie anderen relevanten Kreativtools
  • Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams aus Kreation, Paid, Beratung und Geschäftsführung – Hands-on und immer auf Augenhöhe
  • Erstellung von Behind-the-Scenes-, Vlog- und Social-Media-Content für das Eigenmarketing, sowie proaktives Einfangen von spannenden Situationen im Agenturalltag mit Kamera oder Smartphone
  • Mitwirkung bei Grafikdesign-Aufgaben und kreativen Content-Projekten
  • Du lernst professionelles Multiprojektmanagement, den Umgang mit modernen Tools (insbesondere KI) und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt weiter
  • Du entfaltest deine persönliche Social DNA, indem du aktiv unsere dynamische Wachstumsentwicklung mitgestaltest

was du mitbringst

  • Erste relevante Berufserfahrung mit Bezug zu Videoschnitt, Grafikdesign und Social Content Produktion (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit, Selbstständigkeit o. ä.)
  • Gutes Gespür & Verständnis für kurze Social-Media-Formate, Reels und Vlogs sowie Kamera, Bildgestaltung und Storytelling
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten, Organisations-Skills und unternehmerisches Denken
  • Begeisterung für Social Media, Content Creation und digitale Trends, sowie Motivation, Eigeninitiative, Kommunikationsstärke, Teamgeist und Humor
  • Sehr guteDeutsch- und mindestens guteEnglischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

deine benefits

  • Die Vergütung für diese Position liegt bei 32.000 € -35.000 € brutto pro Jahr, je nach Erfahrung. Zusätzlich kannst Du von limitless Drinks & Snacks im Office, Teamevents, Sonderurlaub, einem Laptop, Premium Smartphone und der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge profitieren.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Remote Work: Du wählst zwischen Mobile-, Home-, oder Full-Office und kannst jederzeit unser Design-Office im Zentrum Frankfurts oder in 15 anderen Städten deutschlandweit nutzen – ergänzt durch ein flexibles Gleitzeitmodell.
  • Team-Spirit: Dich erwartet ein herzliches und offenes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Mit regelmäßigen Teamevents sorgen wir dafür, dass Du dich schnell einlebst und wohlfühlst.
  • Flexibel unterwegs: Egal ob Deutschlandticket oder ein individueller Fahrtkostenzuschuss – wir beteiligen uns individuell an deinen Fahrtkosten
  • Onboarding & Weiterbildung: Neben einem strukturierten Onboarding-Programm profitierst Du von einem jährlichen Weiterbildungsbudget i.H.v. 1.500 €, um immer up-to-date zu bleiben

next steps

  1. Wenn wir dich mit dieser Stellenausschreibung begeistern konnten, dann lade bitte deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Arbeitsproben/Referenzen) in unserem Bewerbungs-Formular hoch.
  2. Falls dein Profil passt, folgt danach ein erstes Kennenlerngespräch mit der Geschäftsführung und ggf. ein Zweitgespräch mit einem Teamlead via Online-Meeting
  3. Wenn es matched, kannst du im nächsten Schritt deine Skills durch die Bearbeitung von Probeaufgaben unter Beweis stellen. An den Aufgaben kannst du gerne von zuhause aus arbeiten. Zur Vorstellung deiner Ergebnisse laden wir dich gerne in unser Office nach Frankfurt ein, um auch das Team kennen zu lernen.
  4. Am Ende des Prozesses wählen wir den oder die neue Kollegin aus, welche ein Vertragsangebot erhält.
Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Marketing and Communications Specialist

Concurrent Technologies Corporation

Remote

Minimum Clearance Required: None

Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain: Secret

Employee Background Check Required

CTC Engineering and Manufacturing: Where Cutting-Edge Innovation Meets Mission-Critical Solutions

The CTC Engineering Division specializes in transforming cutting-edge technologies into real-world solutions. We harness the power of 3D printing, advanced joining techniques like friction stir welding, and cutting-edge design tools to tackle complex challenges for a diverse set of clients.

The Marketing and Communications Specialist is responsible for supporting the development and execution of marketing and communication strategies that enhance organizational visibility and engagement. This role involves creating compelling content, managing projects of moderate complexity, and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with organizational goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation and Management

  • Develop, edit, and manage marketing materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, press releases, and case studies, ensuring alignment with brand standards and organizational messaging.
  • Create and optimize content for digital platforms, including websites, social media, and email campaigns, to drive engagement and awareness.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to produce technical and thought leadership content tailored to target audiences.

Campaign Development and Execution

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute marketing campaigns to promote services, capabilities, and events, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Monitor campaign performance metrics, analyze results, and provide actionable insights to improve effectiveness.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors and partners to ensure timely delivery of campaign assets.

Market Research and Strategy Support

  • Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, competitors, and target audiences to inform marketing strategies and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Analyze data and present findings to support decision-making and strategy development.
  • Contribute to the development of marketing plans and strategies that align with organizational goals.

Event Planning and Coordination

  • Lead the planning and execution of events, including trade shows, webinars, and community outreach initiatives, ensuring all logistical details are managed effectively.
  • Develop promotional materials and coordinate pre-event and post-event communication strategies.
  • Collect and analyze event feedback to identify areas for improvement and measure success.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Interface with internal teams, including technical staff and leadership, to gather information and ensure alignment of marketing efforts with organizational priorities.
  • Build and maintain relationships with external stakeholders, including partners, vendors, and media contacts, to support marketing initiatives.

Administrative and Project Management

  • Maintain marketing databases, including contact lists, project trackers, and content libraries, ensuring accuracy and accessibility.
  • Manage project timelines and deliverables, ensuring deadlines are met and stakeholders are informed of progress.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members as needed.

Concurrent Technologies Corporation (CTC) is preparing to stand up a dedicated team to manage a new, high-priority initiative for the U.S. Navy. This is a unique opportunity to help revitalize and strengthen a critical national security industrial base. As the manager of a large portfolio of innovative projects under a flexible contracting vehicle, CTC will be at the center of this mission. Our role will be to connect cutting-edge solutions from across industry and academia to the Navy's most pressing challenges, accelerating technology adoption and ensuring our nation's defense industrial base has the capacity and capability for decades to come. This is a fast-paced, dynamic program where you will play a foundational role in its success. We are seeking talented professionals to join us in this exciting and impactful work.

As a Marketing and Communications Specialist, you will be an ambassador for this critical program. You will be responsible for building relationships with the innovative small businesses, non-traditional contractors, and academic institutions needed to solve the government's toughest challenges. Your work will be critical to expanding our network of partners.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing, communications, or a related role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with digital marketing tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite) or content management systems (CMS).
  • Knowledge of social media platforms, scheduling tools, and analytics software.
  • Familiarity with government contracting or defense industry marketing practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and interface with external stakeholders.
  • Experience in event planning and coordination.

Work Environment/Conditions:

  • Determined by management if applicable.

Why CTC?

  • Mastering the future of manufacturing: Be at the forefront of technological advancements in advanced manufacturing.
  • Innovate for impact: Your work will push the boundaries of what's possible, from next-generation armaments to groundbreaking environmental solutions that directly impact critical missions and the lives of those protecting our country.
  • Work alongside the best: Collaborate with a passionate team of engineers and scientists, united by a shared drive to excel and a commitment to delivering outstanding results.
  • Leave your mark: CTC is more than just a job. It's a launchpad for your engineering dreams.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Although our work at CTC is extremely important, we also recognize the need for our employees to maintain a proper mix of work and personal life.
  • Visit to learn more.

Join us! CTC offers exceptional career growth, cutting edge technology, educational opportunities, and recognition for quality work.

raw.description:
Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at .

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.

Do you love crafting beautiful and functional customer experiences? Want to work on interesting technical problems for an iOS application around booking flows and payments? Do you have a passion for Swift and Native iOS development with a focus on building reliable applications at scale? Peek is looking for a Senior iOS Engineer. The ideal candidate has 5+ years of development experience with Swift, designing, building, and maintaining robust applications at scale that integrate with multiple backend services. In this role you will have the opportunity to take ownership of critical product areas and use AI tools as a force multiplier on top of your strong fundamentals.

Our engineering group works on several different products and systems: our Peek Pro operations management suite, embeddable scheduling & booking flows, and custom development services for our enterprise customers. This role will primarily focus on supporting the workflows used directly by Peek’s customers and improving overall system performance, security, and reliability.

We’re hiring a Senior iOS Engineer who works AI-first. That means you treat AI as a core part of how you build software and break down ambiguous problems, including delegating tasks to agents, reviewing their work critically, and course-correcting when things go sideways. You'll design and operate complex agent orchestration systems, develop patterns for human-agent collaboration, and ship real product features primarily through agent-assisted development in collaboration with human colleagues.

We work collaboratively, move fast, and value technical quality. If you are excited about the challenge of building an incredible product while working alongside a great engineering team, we’d love to hear from you!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong mobile fundamentals in iOS: API integration, data modeling, robust system design, application reliability, and debugging production issues.

  • Emphasis on creating performant and reliable mobile features that integrate seamlessly with multiple services and products with an attention to high-quality code.

  • A drive for exploring and leading new approaches to complex problems via collaboration with multiple stakeholders across Product, Design, and Engineering, particularly amongst one’s peers.

  • Adaptability to the changing tech industry: demonstrated daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent) in a production engineering workflow.

  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated code critically: you catch logic errors, identify security issues, assess maintainability, and own what gets merged regardless of how it was written.

  • Strong system design instincts: you think about tradeoffs, edge cases, and what happens when things scale or fail.

  • Clear and empathetic communicator: you flag when a spec has holes, you can articulate why you made a technical choice, you enjoy collaboration and seek to understand different perspectives, and you are constructive in any disagreements.

  • Self-motivation and ownership: you will push your work forward without prompting and look for ways to unblock yourself and the team on business priorities; you enjoy ownership over your work and seeing code through from conception to production.

Skills you already have

  • A passion for Swift and mobile development

  • 5+ years of professional development using Swift/Objective-C

  • Solid coding practices including peer code reviews, unit testing, continuous integration, TDD, etc.

  • Experience with mobile application architecture, design patterns, and design patterns at scale

  • Familiarity with unit, integration, and UI testing practices

  • Strong understanding of AI tools and ability to identify pitfalls and course correct AI-generated code based on deep knowledge of the fundamentals of building production software

Nice to haves

  • Experience working with Android development

  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD

  • Experience working on B2B software, on booking flows, or in the travel industry

Peek Travel Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

If you are unable to apply due to incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at . We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible.

raw.description:
About the Role

This is an end-to-end ownership role over a core operational domain, reporting directly to the COO at an AI-native, stablecoin-based clearing and banking platform built for global fintechs and financial institutions. You will design, automate, and scale the systems that make operations run hands-off, measuring success by volume growth with flat headcount rather than team size.

What You'll Do

  • Own one operational domain end-to-end: customer operations, payment operations, or fincrime operations, running it like a product team from day one.

  • Perform the manual work yourself in the first couple of months, sitting in the queue to identify exactly where processes break and defining the KPIs that prove the system works.

  • Ship the first wave of automations within a few months, proving the operating model on a live cohort and driving measurable volume lift.

  • Scale agents across your domain so that humans handle only the highest-risk decisions while the long tail runs hands-off.

  • Spec agents and shape tooling directly alongside Engineering and Product, collaborating on real decisions rather than filing tickets.

  • Draft, defend, and continuously improve escalation paths, SOPs, and operational metrics.

What We're Looking For

  • 3 or more years building products or processes at a bank, fintech, payments, or crypto company, or tier-1 consulting experience with regulated financial services exposure.

  • Production automations or agents shipped and running in live environments today, not proofs of concept.

  • Hands-on experience performing operational work such as queue management, case handling, or transaction processing to understand process pain points firsthand.

  • Experience designing end-to-end operational domains including process design, SOP creation, KPI definition, and tooling selection.

  • Strong background working directly with engineering and product teams to spec and build operational tooling and systems.

  • Familiarity with compliance, risk, fincrime, payment operations, clearing, or settlement workflows is a strong plus.

  • Experience with AI agents, LLMs, or intelligent automation systems is a plus.

  • Automation-first mindset: your first instinct is to build a system, not to add headcount.

  • High agency, ownership mentality, and comfort operating in ambiguity without an established playbook.

  • Based in New York or willing to relocate.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $180,000 to $220,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

On-site in New York, NY, USA.

Job Title: Valuation Services Manager

Reports to: Valuation Managing Director

Job Summary: MaloneBailey, LLPis seeking a highly skilled and motivated individual to serve as the Valuation Services Manager. This individual will primarily perform reviews of third-party appraisals for audit support purposes as well as help grow and deliver consulting valuation services for tax planning, financial reporting, and litigation. The successful candidate will work closely with our accounting and auditing teams to ensure that our clients receive the highest quality service.

Salary Range & Benefits: Commensurate with experience, standard firm benefits

Hours Required: 40 hrs.

FLSA Status: Exempt

About MaloneBailey, LLP

Founded in 1982, MaloneBailey, LLP is a PCAOB-registered, market-leading public accounting firm headquartered in Houston and with offices in Beijing, Shenzhen, and Tokyo. MaloneBailey provides audit and accounting services to public and private companies. We are an exclusive company as one of a few firms worldwide that serve a substantial number of public company clients, including NYSE, NASDAQ, and OTC listed companies. MaloneBailey is a member of HLB, The Global Advisory and Accounting Network. For more information about MaloneBailey, please visit: .

Major Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Perform reviews of third-party appraisals for audit support purposes
  • Plan the scope of work for valuation engagements and oversee day-to-day activities and execution of multiple, concurrent engagements
  • Assume responsibility for quality control and accuracy of client deliverables, and effectively manage risk associated with engagements
  • Manage client relationships and consult with clients in all aspects of the valuation process
  • Explain and articulate valuation methodology issues and document accounting issues clearly
  • Prepare, draft and finalize valuation reports with a clear, concise writing style
  • Service clients from multiple industries and deliver valuation engagements for financial reporting in audit reviews
  • Manage and deliver business and intangible valuations for mergers and acquisitions, financial reporting, tax and regulatory compliance, restructuring and reorganizations, corporate services and management planning purposes

The successful candidate will possess the following qualifications:

  • Valuation or relevant accreditation required
  • 5+ years experience in valuation
  • Experience in valuations of intangible assets (customer relationships, trade names and technology); contingent consideration (earn-outs); share-based award valuations (SARs, options); warrants; convertible preferred stock; and convertible debt.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and tax-related valuations
  • Self-motivated with research, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage client relationships and oversee multiple, concurrent valuation engagements
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical financial modeling skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

Education and Licenses:

  • Undergraduate degree in accounting, finance, economics or related field required
  • ASA, CFA, ABV, CPA certification preferred

Jerry is the #1 rated app for car owners. We help over 5 million people save money on insurance, repairs, and loans—all in one place. Since 2019, we’ve become one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the U.S.

We are looking for an Insurance Compliance & Regulatory Senior Lead to join our Insurance Operations team. Reporting directly to our Senior Manager of Insurance Ops, this role is ideal for an experienced insurance operations leader who excels at solving complex systemic issues, building rigorous compliance frameworks, and acting as the strategic bridge between our customers, carrier partners, state regulators, and internal product teams.

This role may be a fit for you if:

  • You write with judgment, not just accuracy. You can take a complicated file, determine what actually happened, and state a clear, complete, well-supported position under a deadline.

  • You solve problems at the root. You love digging beneath the surface to identify root causes and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves to resolve complex edge cases while mentoring others to do the same.

  • You excel at high-stakes de-escalation. You possess executive-level composure and genuine empathy, easily navigating intense situations with customers, state regulators, and insurance carrier leaders.

  • You turn friction into product fixes. You naturally spot patterns in complaint data and have the strategic mindset to partner with tech, legal, and ops leaders to permanently fix underlying vulnerabilities.

  • Lead Escalation Operations: Oversee the end-to-end investigation and de-escalation framework for critical customer complaints, acting as the final point of escalation for complex issues.

  • Own DOI and Insurance Carrier Responses: Manage carrier audits and state regulatory complaint workflows; author, review, and finalize official correspondence to state departments of insurance, carrier partners, and consumers.

  • Systemic Root-Cause Resolution: Partner with Legal, Product, and Engineering to convert audit findings and complaint trends into product changes, automated checks, and process fixes.

  • Complaint Log & Compliance Controls: Own the complaint log and the workflows behind it, keeping records accurate and audit-ready for market conduct examinations and state data calls, and meeting statutory deadlines and internal SLAs.

  • Carrier Relationship & Claims Support: Serve as the primary operational liaison for carrier partners during high-stakes claims investigations, regulatory inquiries, and information audits.

  • Team Guidance & Coaching: Provide operational guidance, quality oversight, and subject-matter expertise to team members handling customer service, compliance, and claims support.

  • Regulatory Reporting & Documentation: Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of complaint trends, regulatory correspondence, and resolution timelines to support timely responses to DOI inquiries and to inform leadership of emerging compliance risk areas.

What we’re looking for:

  • Active Property & Casualty (P&C) license required (or willingness to obtain it quickly)

  • 5+ years of insurance experience, including 3+ years in state insurance and regulatory compliance.

  • 2+ years in a team lead, managerial, or supervisory role preferred.

  • Proven track record of directly managing state regulatory inquiries (DOI complaints) and carrier audit relationships.

  • Working knowledge of NAIC model regulations, state insurance codes, and market conduct examination standards, with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into operational policy and team-level practice.

  • Exceptional executive-level written and verbal communication skills with an eye for legal and compliance detail.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience using data to drive cross-functional product and operational improvements.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent practical leadership experience).

What’s in it for you?

  • Strategic Leadership & Impact: Work directly with Legal, Product, and Ops leadership to shape Jerry’s operational strategy and customer trust standards.

  • 100% Remote Work: Work from home with all equipment provided.

  • Full Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision insurance, and 401(k) matching.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Employer: Undivided

Job Title: Part-Time Navigator

Undivided is searching for our next round of part-time Navigators to support parents raising children with disabilities. This part-time role presents an exciting opportunity to directly impact families raising children with disabilities.

Navigators partner with parents to map out where they may be able to increase the supports available to them, including insurance, public benefits, and the school system. Our goal is to take away the “don’t know what you don’t know” aspect of parenting and empower our families raising kids with disabilities with information, resources, and support to maximize their child’s potential.

This position provides an opportunity to share your experience and support families while working remotely from your home with flexible work hours.

Primary responsibilities:

  • Develop trust and rapport with clients
  • Work with parents to identify supports that are available to them
  • Work with parents to determine their priorities and goals, both short term and long term
  • Work with parents to develop a personalized action plan for their family
  • Support families by providing resources and guides as needed
  • Facilitate monthly 45-minute Boost calls with your clients
  • Communicate regularly with your clients within our app
  • Attend meetings as requested by clients such as IEPs, IPPs, and Self-Determination meetings
  • Support parents in the use of their account Binder to keep track of their child’s providers, therapies, assessments, evaluations, IEPs, and more

Required education and experience:

Required skills and abilities:

  • Critical thinking skills

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Oversee corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs and social impact strategies.
  • Promote ethical business practices and stakeholder trust.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.
  • Establish governance policies and sustainability reporting structures.
  • Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and audit teams on ESG governance.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.
  • Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

  • Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.
  • Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

  • Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.
  • Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.
  • Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Analytical and risk assessment abilities.
  • Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.
  • ESG ratings and reporting compliance.
  • Stakeholder and investor engagement outcomes.
  • Success of sustainability and CSR initiatives.

Do you love crafting beautiful and functional customer experiences? Want to work on interesting technical problems for an iOS application around booking flows and payments? Do you have a passion for Swift and Native iOS development with a focus on building reliable applications at scale? Peek is looking for a Senior iOS Engineer. The ideal candidate has 5+ years of development experience with Swift, designing, building, and maintaining robust applications at scale that integrate with multiple backend services. In this role you will have the opportunity to take ownership of critical product areas and use AI tools as a force multiplier on top of your strong fundamentals.

Our engineering group works on several different products and systems: our Peek Pro operations management suite, embeddable scheduling & booking flows, and custom development services for our enterprise customers. This role will primarily focus on supporting the workflows used directly by Peek’s customers and improving overall system performance, security, and reliability.

We’re hiring a Senior iOS Engineer who works AI-first. That means you treat AI as a core part of how you build software and break down ambiguous problems, including delegating tasks to agents, reviewing their work critically, and course-correcting when things go sideways. You'll design and operate complex agent orchestration systems, develop patterns for human-agent collaboration, and ship real product features primarily through agent-assisted development in collaboration with human colleagues.

We work collaboratively, move fast, and value technical quality. If you are excited about the challenge of building an incredible product while working alongside a great engineering team, we’d love to hear from you!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong mobile fundamentals in iOS: API integration, data modeling, robust system design, application reliability, and debugging production issues.

  • Emphasis on creating performant and reliable mobile features that integrate seamlessly with multiple services and products with an attention to high-quality code.

  • A drive for exploring and leading new approaches to complex problems via collaboration with multiple stakeholders across Product, Design, and Engineering, particularly amongst one’s peers.

  • Adaptability to the changing tech industry: demonstrated daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or equivalent) in a production engineering workflow.

  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated code critically: you catch logic errors, identify security issues, assess maintainability, and own what gets merged regardless of how it was written.

  • Strong system design instincts: you think about tradeoffs, edge cases, and what happens when things scale or fail.

  • Clear and empathetic communicator: you flag when a spec has holes, you can articulate why you made a technical choice, you enjoy collaboration and seek to understand different perspectives, and you are constructive in any disagreements.

  • Self-motivation and ownership: you will push your work forward without prompting and look for ways to unblock yourself and the team on business priorities; you enjoy ownership over your work and seeing code through from conception to production.

Skills you already have

  • A passion for Swift and mobile development

  • 5+ years of professional development using Swift/Objective-C

  • Solid coding practices including peer code reviews, unit testing, continuous integration, TDD, etc.

  • Experience with mobile application architecture, design patterns, and design patterns at scale

  • Familiarity with unit, integration, and UI testing practices

  • Strong understanding of AI tools and ability to identify pitfalls and course correct AI-generated code based on deep knowledge of the fundamentals of building production software

Nice to haves

  • Experience working with Android development

  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD

About the Role

This is an end-to-end ownership role over a core operational domain, reporting directly to the COO at an AI-native, stablecoin-based clearing and banking platform built for global fintechs and financial institutions. You will design, automate, and scale the systems that make operations run hands-off, measuring success by volume growth with flat headcount rather than team size.

What You'll Do

  • Own one operational domain end-to-end: customer operations, payment operations, or fincrime operations, running it like a product team from day one.

  • Perform the manual work yourself in the first couple of months, sitting in the queue to identify exactly where processes break and defining the KPIs that prove the system works.

  • Ship the first wave of automations within a few months, proving the operating model on a live cohort and driving measurable volume lift.

  • Scale agents across your domain so that humans handle only the highest-risk decisions while the long tail runs hands-off.

  • Spec agents and shape tooling directly alongside Engineering and Product, collaborating on real decisions rather than filing tickets.

  • Draft, defend, and continuously improve escalation paths, SOPs, and operational metrics.

What We're Looking For

  • 3 or more years building products or processes at a bank, fintech, payments, or crypto company, or tier-1 consulting experience with regulated financial services exposure.

  • Production automations or agents shipped and running in live environments today, not proofs of concept.

  • Hands-on experience performing operational work such as queue management, case handling, or transaction processing to understand process pain points firsthand.

  • Experience designing end-to-end operational domains including process design, SOP creation, KPI definition, and tooling selection.

  • Strong background working directly with engineering and product teams to spec and build operational tooling and systems.

  • Familiarity with compliance, risk, fincrime, payment operations, clearing, or settlement workflows is a strong plus.

  • Experience with AI agents, LLMs, or intelligent automation systems is a plus.

  • Automation-first mindset: your first instinct is to build a system, not to add headcount.

  • High agency, ownership mentality, and comfort operating in ambiguity without an established playbook.

  • Based in New York or willing to relocate.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $180,000 to $220,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

On-site in New York, NY, USA.

raw.description:
募集要項

業務内容

ROUTE06（ルートシックス）は、大手企業のビジネスモデル変革を支援するDXパートナーです。

エンタープライズ向けビジネスAPIプラットフォーム「Plain」の提供とアジャイルでの事業化支援によって商取引のプラットフォーム化を実現し、新たな企業価値を生み出すことに貢献します。

開発するプロダクトはモール型EC、OMOストア、マーケットプレイスなど多岐にわたり、事業フェーズも立ち上げからグロースまで幅広くあります。

お客様にいつでも安心してサービスを利用いただけるように、SREとしてサービスの安定性の向上に取り組んでいただきます。

具体的には、インフラの整備、サービスの監視、オペレーションの自動化、パフォーマンス改善やCI/CDの整備など開発生産性を向上するための開発などを含みます。また、ご興味があればバックエンドなどその他領域の開発をしていただくことも可能です。

ROUTE06のSREは、相談しつつ適性、希望、需要に応じて柔軟に担当役割を選択し、お客様にとって最適かつ最善のUXを提供できるよう開発を進めます。

必須要件

  • パブリッククラウドサービス (AWS, GCP) での構築・運用経験がある
  • OS の基本的な知識がある
  • ネットワーク、セキュリティの基本的な知識がある
  • 特定の開発言語での開発実績がある
  • Docker を活用した開発環境の構築・運用経験がある
  • CI/CD 環境の構築・運用の経験がある
  • Infrastructure as Code の実務経験がある
  • 監視ツール (アプリケーション、インフラ) の構築・運用経験がある

歓迎要件

  • 各パブリッククラウドサービスの特性を把握して、適切に選定できる
  • Cloud Design Pattern を理解している
  • パフォーマンスチューニングの経験がある
  • Web サービス開発・運用の経験がある
  • RDBMS, NoSQL での実装経験がある
  • DevOps, SRE の最新情報をキャッチアップしている
    • (例) Web developer Roadmap- DevOps Engineer or SRE に記載されているような情報
  • OSS のリリース・コミット経験がある

求める人物像

  • 私たちの考える、未来への歩み方や姿勢に共感いただける方
  • 「Be a disruptor / 優しい変革者であり続けよう」という行動指針に共感いただける方
  • 好奇心旺盛で、学習が好きな方
  • お互いの仕事への理解と敬意を重視した柔らかいコミュニケーションを大切にしている方
  • 自らの業務領域 / 役割に関係なく、ゴールに対してアクションが取れる方

選考フロー

選考はすべてオンラインで実施します。日本各地からぜひご応募ください。

選考にかかる時間は平均で1.5ヶ月程度ですが、候補者の方の都合にあわせて柔軟に対応いたします。不安な点がある場合にはご相談ください。

雇用条件

雇用形態

  • 正社員 (試用期間: 3ヶ月)

勤務地

  • 在宅勤務を原則としています

勤務体系

  • 裁量労働制；10時〜19時を基本とし、自由に選択していただけます
  • 土日祝休み、入社日に20日の有給休暇を付与、リラックス休暇など

給与

  • スキル・経験・能力に応じて決定いたします (昇給あり)
  • ストックオプション制度あり

その他

  • 育児休業給付金上乗せ手当
  • リモートワーク手当や学習支援制度など

Information

  • コーポレートサイト(JP) / Corporate Site(EN)
  • 採用情報
  • 会社紹介スライド
  • 公式note
  • Acism / Giselle / Liam
  • ROUTE06 Tech Blog
  • エンジニア雑談会

raw.excerpt: Position Overview The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives.
raw.description:
Position Overview

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Oversee corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs and social impact strategies.
  • Promote ethical business practices and stakeholder trust.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.
  • Establish governance policies and sustainability reporting structures.
  • Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and audit teams on ESG governance.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.
  • Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

  • Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.
  • Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

  • Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.
  • Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.
  • Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Analytical and risk assessment abilities.
  • Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.
  • ESG ratings and reporting compliance.
  • Stakeholder and investor engagement outcomes.
  • Success of sustainability and CSR initiatives.

Du bist mit der Ausbildung fertig, weißt nicht was du nach dem Studium machen sollst und hast keine Lust auf einen normalen 9-5 Job, in welchem du mit deinem Fixgehalt abgespeist wirst? Du weißt, du hast größere Amibitionen für dich und dein Privatleben, weshalb du einen Job brauchst, der eine ungedeckelte Verdienstmöglichkeit hat?

Dein Kontostand passt nicht zu deiner Leistung?

Perfekt! Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen, bestehend aus einem Team von vier Leuten, und suchen dieses Jahr Verstärkung von bis zu 12 weiteren Menschen.

Aufgaben

  • Telefonische Kontaktaufnahme mit potenziellen Kunden zur Terminvereinbarung
  • Pflege der Kundendatenbank und Dokumentation der Verkaufsaktivitäten im CRM-System
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung neuer Verkaufsstrategien und Verbesserung bestehender Prozesse

Qualifikation

Lass uns schauen, ob wir gemeinsam deine beruflichen Ziele verwirklichen können. Was du dafür mitbringen musst:

  • Du bist kommunikativ stark und kannst Menschen schnell für dich gewinnen
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten liegt dir im Blut und du bringst frische Ideen ein
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachenniveau
  • Du bist motiviert, in einem kleinen Team Großes zu bewegen und scheust nicht vor Herausforderungen zurück

Benefits

Nun wollen wir dir erzählen, was deine konkreten Vorteile bei FMC sind:

  • Überdurchschnittliche Fixgehalt und zusätzliche Provision für jeden erfolgreich vereinbarten und durchgeführten Termin
  • Deine Persönlichkeitsentwicklung wird massiv gefördert
  • Klare Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten im Vertriebsteam basierend auf Leistung und Engagement

Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten:

  • Setting: Führen von gelegten Erstgesprächen und qualifizieren potenzieller Anfragen
  • Closing: Abschließen von heißen Deals und qualifizierten Kaufinteressenten
  • Endstufe: Vertriebsleitung, Controlling im Sales und Führung deines eigenen Teams

Die Provisionen verdoppeln sich je nach Karrierestufe. Zusätzlich zum Fixgehalt von 2.500 Euro kannst du bei entsprechender Leistung in der Kaltakquise etwa 1.350 €, im Setting rund 2.700 € und im Closing bis zu 5.400 € an Provision verdienen on top zu deinem Grundgehalt.

Einblicke in die Welt eines Start-up Unternehmens und die Chance, am Unternehmenswachstum teilzuhaben

  • Unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld mit erfahrenen Vertriebsprofis und regelmäßigem Coaching
  • Regelmäßige Teambuilding-Aktivitäten wie z.B. gemeinsames Skifahren, Trips nach Spanien, Zypern etc...
  • Möglichkeit 100% Remote zu arbeiten und zu leben, wo du möchtest
  • Möglichkeit, vor Ort in unseren Räumlichkeiten zu arbeiten

Wir freuen uns schon von dir zu hören!

raw.description:
Operations Engineer

Hybrid or Remote (UK-based), Hybrid or Remote (US-based) or In-Office (Singapore-based) Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

As an Operations Engineer, you will ensure the stability, performance, and availability of the Reactive trading platform. This is a hands-on, technical operations role — focused on production systems, infrastructure, and trading workflows rather than client relationship management.

You'll work closely with Engineering, Product, and internal stakeholders as the first line of defence for live trading systems. TechOps owns Level 1 and Level 2 support — monitoring response and alert triage through to the deeper technical investigation, configuration delivery, and post-release verification that sits beneath it — escalating to Level 3 (Engineering and Infrastructure) only when an issue genuinely requires code changes or deep infrastructure intervention. While the role involves supporting client onboarding and integrations, the emphasis is on technical delivery, system correctness, and incident response — not sales or account management.

Reactive runs a globally distributed, follow-the-sun operations team, and we are hiring across our UK, US, and Singapore hubs. You'll provide operational coverage across your regional trading session — the eyes on the platform when your region is live — and hand over cleanly to the next hub as the day moves. In each region you own the full TechOps remit: monitoring and incident response through the session, plus the configuration delivery, onboarding execution, and change work that keeps the platform growing. The UK and US roles are remote; the Singapore role is office-based.

We are a small team that has turned operations into a genuine engineering discipline, and we are investing heavily in AI-assisted tooling and knowledge engineering to keep it that way. This role suits someone with experience in trading or FinTech operations who enjoys working close to production systems, solving complex problems, writing things down properly, and taking ownership in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Work On

Production Monitoring & Incident Response:

  • Monitor live trading systems across multiple regions, venues, and asset classes — you are the eyes on the platform during the trading session

  • Own Level 1 and Level 2 response: triage alerts, run standard runbook actions (restart, rollback, failover, feature flag), investigate deeply, declare severity, and coordinate incidents — escalating to Level 3 (Engineering / Infrastructure) only when code or deep infrastructure intervention is genuinely required

  • Participate in failover and disaster-recovery readiness — rehearsed, playbook-driven, and time-bound

  • Drive root-cause analysis and blameless post-incident reviews, turning every incident into a runbook or a tooling improvement

Configuration Delivery & Production Change:

  • Deliver the production-change pipeline that brings new clients, liquidity providers, venues, and capabilities live — the largest share of the work

  • Configure and maintain FIX sessions by function — streaming, RFQ, algo, and post-trade — alongside cross-rates, indications of interest, subscriptions, certificate rotations, and pool registrations

  • Execute changes safely against the platform's deployment configuration, with schema updates, ACL coordination, and post-release verification

  • Support migrations, decommissioning, and the follow-on work that keeps the production estate coherent as it grows

Client Onboarding & Connectivity:

  • Own the technical execution of client and LP onboarding: credentials, IPs, conformance and UAT testing, cross-connects, day-1 readiness, and post-go-live verification

  • Act as the technical point of contact during onboarding, giving Client Services the information they need to manage the relationship

  • Monitor and validate FIX message flows, identifying issues related to execution, routing, or market-data

  • Maintain clear, accurate documentation for configurations, onboarding steps, and troubleshooting

Knowledge Engineering, Automation & Continuous Improvement:

  • Contribute to capacity and infrastructure planning — session load balancing, gateway placement, and utilisation monitoring — jointly with Performance Engineering and Infrastructure

  • Coordinate with external vendors and counterparties: network and colocation providers, post-trade vendors, and liquidity providers and their infrastructure teams

  • Identify recurring issues and contribute to long-term fixes and preventative improvements

  • Help build operational tooling, automation, runbooks, and the knowledge corpus — including AI-assisted investigation and documentation — that reduce toil and make the platform less dependent on individual memory

What We Need

Technical:

  • 2+ years' experience in operations or production support within trading or FinTech

  • Working knowledge of the FIX protocol, ideally in FX or electronic trading environments

  • Understanding of trading infrastructure, networking, and low-latency connectivity

  • Experience with monitoring and alerting tools in live production environments

  • Linux fundamentals — our platform runs on Linux throughout

  • Comfortable with configuration-as-code — Git, structured config (YAML), and making changes that are reviewed, version-controlled, and verified before they reach production

  • Scripting and automation (e.g. Bash, Python) — used daily to investigate, automate, and reduce toil; you don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to read and write working scripts

How you work:

  • You own it. When a production issue lands, you take responsibility — you investigate, you escalate when needed, you close the loop. You don't wait to be told

  • You stay calm under pressure. Trading systems don't pause for debugging. You can think clearly, prioritise effectively, and communicate status when things go wrong

  • You write things down. Runbooks, configuration notes, post-incident reviews — documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. Clear, proactive communication with engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike. When something breaks, people need to know what's happening and what you're doing about it

  • You improve things. You spot recurring problems and fix them properly — automation, better tooling, clearer processes. You don't just fight the same fires repeatedly

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools to amplify our operational capability — from incident investigation to documentation. You should be curious and willing to learn, and comfortable helping build the corpus that makes those tools better

What You Get

  • Real systems — a market-leading trading platform with genuine scale and technical depth

  • Breadth — exposure to multiple asset classes, LP integrations, and global trading infrastructure

  • A genuinely technical Ops role — this is engineering-led operations with ownership and impact, not ticket-shuffling

  • An excellent team — experienced engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — competitive compensation and benefits aligned to your local market

  • Flexible working — remote-friendly in the UK and US; office-based and collaborative in Singapore. We trust our people to deliver

  • Growth — as the platform scales, so does the opportunity. Operations engineers who understand the full system are invaluable

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the country associated with the location advertised for this role (UK, US, or Singapore, as applicable). We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any location.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

Imerza is a global digital twin consultancy partnering with visionary placemakers - developers, architects, and brands - to visualize complex information and data across every stage of the development lifecycle. From concepting to closing and beyond, we deliver measurable value through immersive intelligence: transforming raw geospatial and project data into powerful, real-time 3D environments that drive better decisions.

Imerza is part of the Together Group - a collective of world-class creative and marketing agencies including Noe & Associates, Visualisation One, Purple, Construct, Folk at Purple, HotPot China, and North Six. Together Group brings together specialist expertise across branding, visualisation, communications, and digital experience, giving Imerza access to an unparalleled network of talent and resources to deliver transformative outcomes for clients globally.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and manage all GIS technical deliverables across multiple projects, ensuring timely, high-quality outputs aligned with client requirements and company standards.
- Oversee the full GIS workflow, from data acquisition and processing to final integration into immersive environments.
- Maintain strict adherence to standardised data structures, schemas, naming conventions, and metadata protocols for all geospatial datasets.
- Develop, implement, and enforce best-practice GIS data management policies to ensure consistency, accuracy, and scalability.
- Perform advanced geospatial data processing, cleaning, transformation, and quality assurance using ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar platforms.
- Prepare and optimise GIS datasets (vector, raster, elevation/DEM, 3D features, and attribute data) for ingestion into Unreal Engine.
- Utilise Unreal Engine tools and plugins (e.g. ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine) to import, geo-reference, and integrate GIS data into real-time 3D environments and digital twins.
- Collaborate closely with Unreal Engine developers, 3D artists, and visualisation teams to troubleshoot geospatial integration issues (coordinate systems, scale, precision, performance optimisation).
- Ensure geospatial accuracy, coordinate reference system alignment, and visual fidelity when translating GIS data into Unreal Engine scenes.
- Manage version control, backups, and archiving of GIS datasets to support project iteration and long-term asset reuse.
- Document GIS processes, data pipelines, and Unreal Engine ingestion workflows to facilitate team knowledge sharing and onboarding.
- Identify and implement opportunities to automate GIS-to-Unreal data pipelines for increased efficiency on large-scale projects.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior GIS team members on data standards, Unreal integration techniques, and project-specific requirements.
- Research and source GIS datasets to support world-building teams.
- Stay current with advancements in GIS technologies, game-engine geospatial tools, and emerging best practices for immersive digital twin development.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:

- Proven senior-level experience in GIS data management, processing, and analysis.
- Deep proficiency with ArcGIS, QGIS, or comparable GIS platforms.
- Hands-on experience integrating GIS data into Unreal Engine, including familiarity with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine or similar geospatial game-engine plugins.
- Strong understanding of coordinate reference systems, projections, and geospatial accuracy requirements.
- Experience preparing and optimising vector, raster, DEM/elevation, and 3D feature datasets for real-time 3D environments.
- Ability to develop and enforce data standards, schemas, and documentation across teams.
- Experience with pipeline automation and scripting (Python or similar) for GIS data workflows.
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills
- comfortable working cross-functionally with 3D artists, developers, and project managers.
- Experience managing and mentoring junior team members.

Nice to Have:

- Background in real estate, architecture, urban planning, or related property development industries.
- Familiarity with digital twin platforms and immersive visualisation pipelines.
- Experience with game engines beyond Unreal Engine (e.g. Unity).
- Knowledge of BIM data and its integration with GIS environments.

What We Offer

- A globally distributed, collaborative team at the cutting edge of immersive technology.
- Exposure to high-profile, visionary real estate and placemaking projects worldwide.
- The opportunity to shape GIS best practices and build scalable workflows in an innovative, fast-growing consultancy.
- Flexible, remote-first working environment.
