Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

The role

As a Senior Product Manager at Chooose, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

This role reports to the CTO.

This is a remote role that must be based in Massachusetts, New York, Pennsylvania, Maryland, or Florida

What you’ll do

  • Own the vision, roadmap and execution for a Chooose domain, balancing intuition with data

  • Deeply understand the aviation fuel market and our customers’ needs by spending time with customers

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

  • Minimum 4 years of product management or adjacent product-building experience in an enterprise context

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on tools

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems, such as prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments (Figma)

  • Fluency in data and experimentation, and understanding when the answer cannot be found in the data

  • Proven ability to lead small, technical teams toward ambitious product goals with urgency

  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, synthesizing complex systems into compelling narratives

  • Native-level English writing and speaking skills

Not for you if

  • You prefer product strategy briefings over hands-on delivery

  • You’re not building with AI

Nice to have

  • Experience building in financial, enterprise, or other compliance-heavy domains requiring precision and complex systems thinking

  • Experience in high growth startups

  • Experience getting results on a distributed team

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will most likely involve a practical exercise to show your work. The third and final phase consists of a few one-on-one conversation members of the executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring for enough time to get to know one another.

Pay, perks, & more

We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, voluntary 401k contributions, paid parental leave, a robust PTO package, the option to participate in our employee equity program, flexible work hours, and access to 'Spaces' coworking space.
We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.
Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both salary and equity in Chooose.
Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.
Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Designer to shape intuitive, high-quality product experiences across BJAK's financial products.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving product problems through thoughtful interface design. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to simplify complex financial workflows into experiences that feel fast, intuitive and trustworthy.

What You'll Own

  • Design end-to-end product experiences from concept to production.

  • Transform product requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.

  • Design intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial products.

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems and reusable UI components.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Improve usability through rapid iteration using product data and user feedback.

  • Maintain consistency across mobile and web experiences.

  • Continuously refine interactions, accessibility and overall product quality.


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience designing digital products.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking and excellent visual design.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Strong understanding of design systems, component libraries and responsive design.

  • Strong understanding of information architecture and user flows.

  • Excellent visual design skills including typography, spacing, layout and interaction design.

  • Ability to simplify complex workflows into intuitive experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout

  • Component Libraries


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks about solving customer problems, not just designing screens.

  • Balances business goals with user experience.

  • Obsesses over clarity, simplicity and consistency.

  • Works collaboratively with engineers and product teams.

  • Takes ownership from idea through launch.

  • Continuously improves products using real user insights.


This Role Is Not For

  • Designers who only focus on visuals without considering usability.

  • People who require fully detailed specifications before contributing.

  • Designers who struggle to explain design decisions.

  • Individuals who don't enjoy fast-moving startup environments.

  • Candidates who exaggerate ownership or cannot explain what they personally designed.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Hong Kong. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Hong Kong.


Language

English is our primary working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process

  1. Portfolio Review

  2. Practical Design Task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific Interview

  4. CEO / Final Interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within one week.

募集要項

業務内容

ROUTE06（ルートシックス）は、大手企業のビジネスモデル変革を支援するDXパートナーです。

エンタープライズ向けビジネスAPIプラットフォーム「Plain」の提供とアジャイルでの事業化支援によって商取引のプラットフォーム化を実現し、新たな企業価値を生み出すことに貢献します。

ROUTE06のDesignerは、顧客のパートナーとして、顧客のプロダクトにも責任を持ち、デジタルプロダクトの立ち上げから、成長 / 運用フェーズまでを継続支援します。お客様のサービスについて、徹底的に調査、分析(定量 / 定性）を行い、お客様の課題を把握し、適切な課題解決を提案・推進します。ROUTE06としての、商品 / サービス開発にも従事します。

以下を他のメンバーと連携しながら推進します。

  • 顧客企業の事業戦略支援 / 提案 / デザイン
    • 顧客企業、及び顧客企業のプロダクトの課題を調査＆分析 / デザインリサーチ
    • 情報設計
      • タッチポイント・カスタマージャーニーの設計
      • ワイヤーフレーム作成
    • 商品 / サービス設計(MVP)、及び提案 / デザイン
    • サービスグロース提案とその推進 / デザイン
    • プロダクトのプロトタイプの設計 / デザイン
    • プロダクトのUIデザイン
    • タイポグラフィを使用したビジュアルデザイン
    • コンセプトデザイン
    • ロゴデザイン
  • 新規サービスの設計 / デザイン
    • 市場調査
    • 情報設計
      • タッチポイント・カスタマージャーニーの設計
      • ワイヤーフレーム作成
    • 商品 / サービス設計(MVP)、及び提案 / デザイン
    • デザインシステム / デザインガイドラインの構築
    • サービスの継続的なグロース

必須要件

  • WebデザインやUIデザインの実務経験
  • デザインツールを使ったデザイン制作およびプロトタイピング制作経験
    • 例：Figma、Adobe、Sketchなど。ただしツールの種類は問わない
    • 弊社ではFigmaをメインのデザインツールとして使用しています

歓迎要件

  • 経験
    • 幅広い業界でのデザイン経験
      • UXデザイン経験
      • UIデザイン経験
  • スキル
    • 自ら考えたデザインを、非デザイナーになぜこうしたのか説明することができる
    • Web / Appのデザインができる
    • デザインガイドラインを作成することができる
    • プロダクトや会社のブランドデザインを作成することができる
    • お客様の課題から最適なMVPを設計提案できる
    • 他のデザイナー、及びエンジニア / データアナリスト / プロジェクトマネージャと連携してタスクを推進できる

デザイン環境

以下、現状の利用実績・予定を記載しつつ、プロジェクトによって最適なものを選定し続けます。

  • デザインツール: Figma、Adobe Photoshop、Adobe Illustrator
  • ワイヤーフレーム等: FigJam、Miro

求める人物像

  • 私たちの考える、未来への歩み方や姿勢に共感いただける方
  • 「Be a disruptor / 優しい変革者であり続けよう」という行動指針に共感いただける方
  • 好奇心旺盛で、学習が好きな方
  • お互いの仕事への理解と敬意を重視した柔らかいコミュニケーションを大切にしている方
  • 自らの業務領域 / 役割に関係なく、ゴールに対してアクションが取れる方

選考フロー

選考はすべてオンラインで実施します。日本各地からぜひご応募ください。

選考にかかる時間は平均で1.5ヶ月程度ですが、候補者の方の都合にあわせて柔軟に対応いたします。不安な点がある場合にはご相談ください。

雇用条件

雇用形態

  • 正社員 (試用期間: 3ヶ月)

勤務地

  • 在宅勤務を原則としています

勤務体系

  • 裁量労働制；10時〜19時を基本とし、自由に選択していただけます
  • 土日祝休み、入社日に20日の有給休暇を付与、リラックス休暇など

給与

  • スキル・経験・能力に応じて決定いたします (昇給あり)
  • ストックオプション制度あり

その他

  • 育児休業給付金上乗せ手当
  • リモートワーク手当や学習支援制度など

Information

  • コーポレートサイト(JP) / Corporate Site(EN)
  • 採用情報
  • 会社紹介スライド
  • 公式note
  • Acism / Giselle / Liam
  • ROUTE06 Tech Blog
  • エンジニア雑談会

We are looking for an eager, self-starting Brokerage Manager to help grow our business. Over the last 30 years, First American Insurance Underwriters (FAIU) has been a leading national insurance wholesaler/ brokerage general agency dedicated to providing great service, solutions, education, and partnership to independent insurance advisors, brokers, and financial institutions.

Paired is a premier staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in connecting talented professionals with outstanding remote work opportunities around the globe. Our focus is on matching skilled individuals with companies that are looking for their unique talents, enabling a seamless collaboration regardless of geographical boundaries.

We are currently collaborating with a rapidly growing Healthcare Marketing Agency based in the US to find a skilled UI/UX Designer. This is a remote position that offers the flexibility to work from anywhere while crafting impactful user experiences for a range of healthcare marketing solutions.

Position Overview:

As a UI/UX Designer, you will be responsible for creating engaging and user-friendly interfaces for our client's digital marketing platforms. You will work closely with the marketing and content teams to ensure that all digital assets are not only visually appealing but also effectively communicate the desired message to the target audience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement responsive web experiences with a focus on layout, typography, color, media, and accessibility.
  • Develop wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to visualize and refine concepts before implementation.
  • Create and maintain design systems and component libraries in Figma, ensuring consistency across projects.
  • Collaborate with marketing, development, and content teams to ensure cohesive branding and UX/UI strategies.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing to enhance user engagement and conversion rates.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining high-quality design outputs.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in UX/UI design and web technologies.
  • Stay informed about the latest industry trends in user experience and healthcare marketing.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in UI/UX design, preferably in a marketing or web development agency.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma, including variables and design systems.
  • Experience designing responsive websites across multiple devices.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing UX/UI design skills and creative thinking.
  • Excellent written and spoken English skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.
  • Keen attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with user research, usability testing, and user feedback integration.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate effectively across departments.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
  • Passion for creating meaningful user experiences in healthcare and marketing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with conversion rate optimization (CRO) and A/B testing.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Familiarity with life sciences or healthcare industries.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Work From Home
  • Flexible Hours
  • Global Exposure

raw.description:
募集要項

業務内容

ROUTE06（ルートシックス）は、大手企業のビジネスモデル変革を支援するDXパートナーです。

エンタープライズ向けビジネスAPIプラットフォーム「Plain」の提供とアジャイルでの事業化支援によって商取引のプラットフォーム化を実現し、新たな企業価値を生み出すことに貢献します。

商取引のプラットフォーム化に必要な機能を包括的に提供するシステムを目指し、現在はBtoBの商取引に重点を置きつつ実際のプロジェクトに伴走しながら開発を進めています。

ROUTE06のFrontend Engineerは、価値提供先となる事業ドメインの横断的理解とそれに必要なコラボレーション、フロントエンドアーキテクチャの設計と開発、システムの信頼性向上やパフォーマンス改善など、幅広い行動選択肢の中から、チームで相談しつつ適性/希望/需要に応じて柔軟に選択し、顧客企業やエンドユーザーにとって最適かつ最善なUXを提供できるよう開発を進めます。

必須要件

  • ReactやTypeScriptなどを用いたWebアプリケーション開発の実務経験
  • フロントエンドアーキテクチャを検討、提案した実務経験
  • Gitなどのバージョン管理システムを利用したチームでの実務経験

歓迎要件

  • React、Next.jsの実務経験
  • GraphQLの実務経験
  • Next.jsの実務経験
  • フロントエンドアーキテクチャを設計、主導した実務経験
  • Testing Trophy に則ったテスト設計の実践経験
  • Visual Regression Testの運用経験
  • Webアプリケーションフレームワークを用いたバックエンド開発の実務経験

技術環境

以下、現状の利用実績・予定を記載しつつ、プロジェクトによって最適なものを選定し続けます。

  • 開発言語: JavaScript、TypeScript、Kotlin、Rubyなど
  • フレームワーク: Next.js、React、Spring Boot、NestJS、Ruby on Railsなど
  • データベース: MySQL、Redis、PostgreSQL、DynamoDB、BigQueryなど
  • その他の技術要素: GraphQL、Storybookなど

求める人物像

  • 私たちの考える、未来への歩み方や姿勢に共感いただける方
  • 「Be a disruptor / 優しい変革者であり続けよう」という行動指針に共感いただける方
  • 好奇心旺盛で、学習が好きな方
  • お互いの仕事への理解と敬意を重視した柔らかいコミュニケーションを大切にしている方
  • 自らの業務領域 / 役割に関係なく、ゴールに対してアクションが取れる方

選考フロー

選考はすべてオンラインで実施します。日本各地からぜひご応募ください。

選考にかかる時間は平均で1.5ヶ月程度ですが、候補者の方の都合にあわせて柔軟に対応いたします。不安な点がある場合にはご相談ください。

雇用条件

雇用形態

  • 正社員 (試用期間: 3ヶ月)

勤務地

  • 在宅勤務を原則としています

勤務体系

  • 裁量労働制；10時〜19時を基本とし、自由に選択していただけます
  • 土日祝休み、入社日に20日の有給休暇を付与、リラックス休暇など

給与

  • スキル・経験・能力に応じて決定いたします (昇給あり)
  • ストックオプション制度あり

その他

  • 育児休業給付金上乗せ手当
  • リモートワーク手当や学習支援制度など

raw.description:
Associate Care Manager (MA/CNA Level) – BabyscriptsAbout Babyscripts

Babyscripts is a leading innovator in digital health, dedicated to transforming maternal care through remote patient monitoring (RPM) and patient engagement. Our digital tools help healthcare providers monitor, educate, and support their patients in real time, enhancing overall care coordination and improving health outcomes.

About the Role

We are seeking a full-time Associate Care Manager to support patient engagement, care coordination, and remote patient monitoring efforts. This role is ideal for candidates with a background as a Medical Assistant (MA), Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA), or similar healthcare role with experience in care coordination, patient navigation, or remote patient monitoring (RPM).

The Associate Care Manager works closely with patients enrolled in Babyscripts' RPM programs, ensuring compliance with care plans, addressing questions, and escalating concerns to clinical staff when needed. While prior experience in maternal health or OB care is a plus, it is not required. The ideal candidate is passionate about patient engagement, digital health, and improving healthcare outcomes.

This is a remote position with structured yet flexible scheduling, offering an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on maternal healthcare while working in an innovative and fast-growing digital health company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with patients through in-app messaging, phone calls, and telehealth check-ins to support adherence to their care plans.
  • Monitor patient data (such as blood pressure readings) and conduct follow-ups with patients who have not submitted readings in several days.
  • Educate patients on how to use digital health tools and properly measure vital signs.
  • Escalate concerns related to abnormal patient readings or reported symptoms to RN Care Managers or clinical teams based on established protocols.
  • Provide care coordination support, including appointment scheduling and answering routine patient questions.
  • Assist in patient onboarding for Babyscripts' RPM program, ensuring patients understand expectations and have access to necessary resources.
  • Document all interactions accurately in Babyscripts' care management platform.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience in care coordination, patient engagement, or remote patient monitoring (RPM) is highly preferred.
  • Background as a Medical Assistant (MA), Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA), or similar healthcare role.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a patient-first mindset.
  • Proficient with digital health tools, EHR systems, and telehealth platforms.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining productivity.
  • Comfortable with structured but flexible scheduling, ensuring full-time work commitment.
  • Bilingual (Spanish preferred) is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Flexible PTO Policy: Babyscripts offers flexible paid time off for full-time employees, ensuring a healthy work-life balance while maintaining coverage and performance expectations. Employees are encouraged to take at least 3–4 weeks off per year and must meet job performance expectations to qualify for discretionary time off.
  • Performance Expectations for Flexible PTO Eligibility:
    • Must maintain full-time status (average of 40 hours/week over a rolling 3-month period).
    • PTO requests must be submitted in advance to ensure team coverage.
    • Employees must meet engagement and documentation benchmarks to continue qualifying for discretionary PTO.
  • Bonus Potential: Employees are eligible for quarterly bonuses based on patient engagement, quality benchmarks, and documentation accuracy, with an annual bonus potential of up to $2,500.
  • Flexible Scheduling: Employees must maintain expected work hours while having flexibility in when they work based on business needs.
  • Full-time employees receive:
    • Medical, dental, vision coverage
    • 401(k) options
    • Work-from-home stipend

Staffing & Coverage Expectations

  • Employees are expected to maintain a full-time work schedule (40 hours per week).
  • PTO must be planned in advance to ensure adequate team coverage.
  • Coverage for patient interactions is a priority—employees should communicate availability adjustments ahead of time to allow for rescheduling.
  • In cases of urgent or last-minute PTO, employees should work with their manager to coordinate appropriate patient handoff procedures.

Who We Are

Ameelio is a nonprofit tech startup that builds free digital solutions for justice systems to advance rehabilitation and human connection. Our funders include Reid Hoffman, Jack Dorsey, Schmidt Futures, and Arnold Ventures.

We’re growing quickly—and we know that some of the best people don’t fit into a single job description. If you're excited about our mission but don’t see a role that matches your background, we encourage you to apply here. We’re always looking for builders, strategists, technologists, and mission-driven doers to help us reshape the justice system.

Why Apply

If you thrive in fast-moving, high-impact environments, are passionate about civic technology, and want to contribute your skills toward justice reform, we’d love to hear from you.

What You Can Expect

Our Culture

  • Your work will directly contribute to dismantling an exploitative industry and providing essential services to incarcerated individuals and their families.
  • We are a growing startup, which means everyone has a high degree of autonomy and ownership over their work. There are ample opportunities to lead projects.

Submit your resume and a brief note about what excites you about working at Ameelio. If a role opens up that aligns with your skills, we’ll reach out. Even if we don’t have an immediate match, we’ll keep your application on file for future opportunities.

raw.excerpt: About DarkroomDarkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

This role owns Darkroom's creator program and builds Shadow's from nothing. The Darkroom program is run today by the VP of Marketing, which caps how far it can go.

Our creators are operators. They run brands, agencies, and growth teams, and their audiences are founders, marketers, and operators making buying decisions. That makes this a B2B creator role, which is the part we care about most. Sourcing is judged on operating credibility and point of view rather than follower count, and the commercial structure runs closer to a partnership than to a rate card for a sponsored post. Someone whose background is fashion or consumer product influencer campaigns will find that very little of that experience transfers.

The two sides of the job have separate goals. At Darkroom you grow the roster and the volume and quality of what it publishes across Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube. At Shadow you build a creator-led acquisition funnel that does not exist yet, measured on signups rather than on Darkroom's follower numbers. You will report to the VP of Marketing and work alongside a designer, a video editor, and a Marketing Ops & Social Media Manager who keeps the creator CRM current. Design and video are not your job. You brief the designer and video editor for the assets creators need, and you own the relationships and the funnel. This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone, and we are hiring for it in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

What You'll Do

Darkroom's Creator Program

  • Run the existing roster day to day: relationships, briefs, scheduling, and the cadence of what they publish.

  • Source new operator-creators, judged on what they have built and how sharp their thinking is.

  • Raise the volume and quality of creator content across Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube, working toward the Instagram target of 40,000 followers by the end of 2027.

  • Collect and organize reviews, testimonials, and social proof from creators and clients so the rest of the team can use them.

Shadow's Creator Channel

  • Build the channel from zero: find the operators whose audiences are Shadow's buyers, and bring them on.

  • Design a creator-led acquisition funnel, from post to signup, and work with the Retention Marketer on the email path behind it.

  • Report on it as its own channel, measured on signups and pipeline rather than folded into Darkroom's numbers.

Across Both

  • Structure and manage the commercial side of each relationship: fees, affiliate and referral terms, co-marketing, advisory arrangements.

  • Feed creators the strategy, data, and product access they need to say something specific rather than generic.

  • Keep the creator CRM accurate, working with the Marketing Ops Manager.

  • Know which creators are producing results and which are not, and act on it.

What We're Looking For

  • A real understanding of B2B. This is the most important thing on this list. Our creators talk to founders, operators, and growth teams, and a creator program run like a consumer brand's will not work here.

  • Genuine experience running creator, partner, or community programs where the creators were practitioners with an audience. Years matter less than whether you have actually done it.

  • Enough commerce and growth literacy to hold a real conversation with someone who runs a brand or an agency. Creators at this level work out within one exchange whether you know the space.

  • Smart in a way that shows up in the work. You can judge whether an audience is real, structure a deal that works for both sides, and brief someone without flattening their voice.

  • Experience structuring the commercial side of these relationships, including fees, affiliate and referral terms, and co-marketing.

  • Organized enough to run a growing roster without anything slipping: contracts, deliverables, payment schedules, all of it.

  • AI-native. Our team works alongside AI for analytics, reporting, and drafting, and you should be excited to build workflows with it.

  • Comfortable building a channel that does not exist yet, for Shadow, while running an established one, for Darkroom, at the same time.

Bonus Points

  • You have built an audience of your own, on any platform.

  • Experience marketing a SaaS or software product to a business audience.

  • Agency, ecommerce, or performance marketing background.

  • You already know creators in the commerce, growth, or B2B software space.

  • Familiarity with Notion, our operating layer.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Lead on content creation and communications, including website, blogs, email campaigns, events, webinars, newsletters.
  • Track and analyse member engagement. This includes collecting data on the frequency of meet-ups, chat messages, social media engagement and more.
  • Monitor and be a source of customer feedback for the company, and share internally such that it guides our future development.
  • Identify and reach out to similarly aligned communities, organisations, influencers, bloggers or potential partners to support the growth of our community.
  • Develop collaborations and partnerships that can help us grow.
  • Develop relationships with organisations, stakeholders and influencers in positive ageing – helping to position Freebird as a key player in the global silver economy.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest trends in healthy ageing; includes attending industry events, reading industry news, following thought leaders in the field.
  • A real “people” person. Positive and progressive in all interactions.
  • Excellent knowledge of social media platforms and social media management tools.
  • Superior organisational skills; ability to monitor and facilitate communication across multiple channels.
  • 4+ years experience in a previous community management or related role. Customer service experience is a premium.
  • Strong understanding and experience of business operations and processes, including project management.
  • Strong computer skills, including knowledge of relevant software programs and tools, including analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including grammar and spelling, and the ability to create high quality engaging content.
  • Excellent analytical skills, with strong attention to detail.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, or other related fields.
  • Demonstrate integrity, dependability, accountability, self-awareness, work ethic, empathy and compassion.
  • Self-directed with ability to get lots done with limited guidance. Takes ownership.
  • Be okay with making mistakes. We are all learning and mistakes are the byproduct of doing something new. Making them is part of the journey, dwelling on them is not.

What’s in it for you?

  • Coming in at exciting early stage in an award-winning social impact start-up.
  • Working directly with the Founders on all aspects of the business, gaining first-hand experience of bringing a high-growth startup to life and executing on our ambitions.
  • Remote-first & flexible culture: we believe in outcomes over time-keeping.
  • Use of Founders Factory office at fantastic location near Covent Garden, London.
  • Be part of the Founders Factory entrepreneurial ecosystem, with access to excellent free training, advice and contacts.
  • Your work will have real & meaningful impact in improving the lives of older people.
  • Personal development – you will have exposure to all aspects of the business with rare opportunities for learning and growth.
  • Work from home – with occasional team days in London.
  • Salary £30-33K with early employee equity options.
  • Generous pension scheme and annual holiday entitlement.

We are committed to building a diverse culture and are eager to receive applications from all backgrounds. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination.

Freebird Club is a social travel & homestay club for the over 50s. It offers an accessible new mode of travelling for older adults, a fun way to meet and enjoy social & cultural interaction, and a means to unlock value in their homes and earn income in later life. Positioned at the intersection of traveltech and agetech, where the silver economy meets the sharing economy, Freebird addresses social issues such as loneliness and lack of opportunities for older adults through a tech enabled community model. Our mission is to connect, empower and enrich the lives of older adults through meaningful travel & social experiences.

Our ambitions are big, bold and global. We are looking to build a highly talented, mission-driven team that is excited at the prospect of enriching the lives of older people globally, and creating a more age-friendly and accessible world that we can all look forward to growing old in.

Freebird Club is backed by Founders Factory and Nesta. Founders Factory builds and funds start-ups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. London UK base; remote first.

High Ticket Fitness Sales | Full Time | Commission Based

Experience selling personal training, fitness memberships, or wellness services strongly preferred. Former Fitness Directors, Membership Advisors, and gym sales professionals are encouraged to apply

Do you love sales, connecting with people, and helping others change their lives?

Are you a strong closer who wants to work remotely and get paid based on performance?

Do you have a passion for fitness, wellness, and nutrition?

If yes, keep reading.

Svetness is one of the largest in-home personal training companies in the United States, serving over 1,000 clients nationwide. We are growing quickly and looking for motivated, coachable, high-performing sales professionals to join our team.

You can check out our client reviews here:

About the Role

This is a full-time remote B2C sales position selling high-ticket personal training packages to warm inbound leads who are actively looking for at-home personal training.

Package values typically range from $5,000 to $15,000.

You will be taking Zoom consultations with prospects, building trust, understanding their goals, and helping them enroll into the right program.

What You Will Do

  • Take 4 to 6 Zoom sales calls per day, typically 1 hour each
  • Close warm inbound leads into personal training packages
  • Attend daily sales meetings
  • Complete daily reporting and admin tasks
  • Work closely with appointment setters and the sales team
  • Follow the company sales process and coaching guidance

Requirements

  • Must be able to commit to full-time hours of at least 40 hours per week
  • Must be available for some evenings and weekends
  • Strong English communication skills required
  • Must be confident on the phone and on Zoom
  • Must be coachable, driven, and performance-focused
  • Must thrive in a fast-paced team environment

Who This Is For

This role is for someone who:

  • Wants to be paid based on results
  • Is hungry, disciplined, and competitive
  • Wants long-term growth with a strong company
  • Has experience in sales, closing, prospecting, or client-facing roles
  • Has a real interest in fitness, nutrition, and wellness

Experience in high-ticket sales, insurance, phone sales, outbound prospecting, cold calling, door-to-door sales, or in-person sales is a major plus.

Who This Is Not For

This role is not for someone who:

  • Is not comfortable with performance-based compensation
  • Does not communicate fluently and professionally in English
  • Does not want to work hard or move fast
  • Is not open to feedback, coaching, and accountability

Compensation

This is a commission-based role.

You will earn approximately 8% to 12% per closed deal, based on Gross contract value, not only cash collected upfront.

Expected earnings:

  • First 3 to 6 months:

    $7,000+ per month

  • 6 to 12 months:
    $10,000+ per month
  • Strong performers can exceed this range

This is a real opportunity for someone who wants to work from home and build strong income through performance.

How to Apply

Step 1: Record a short video introduction using a shareable link. Loom is recommended.

Please answer these questions in your video:

  • Tell us a bit about yourself
  • Why would you stand out compared to other candidates?
  • How have you applied your sales skills in everyday life?
  • How do you respond to coaching and constructive criticism?
  • What appeals to you about fitness and wellness?

IMPORTANT:

APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO SUBMISSION WILL BE AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED.

Step 2: Attach your resume or CV

If qualified, a member of our team will reach out to schedule an interview.

If this posting is live, the position is still open. Apply as soon as possible, as we are actively hiring and the role may fill quickly.

We look forward to hearing from you.

raw.description:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.

The MinIO team is looking for a technically strong curriculum engineer who is equally at home on a sales call and building with the technology underneath it — whether that's a data pipeline or an agentic AI stack. In this role, you'll build and deliver training across the full spectrum of MinIO's technical audience — from storage administrators learning to operate AIStor in production, to field architects preparing for competitive enterprise deals, to partners who need to sell and position MinIO products effectively.

This role has real variety. On any given week, you might be building a hands-on lab, standing up an agent memory demo, delivering a live enablement session for field architects, adapting a sales deck into a teachable module for partners, or wrapping our core curriculum in a use-case narrative for a specific deployment context. You enjoy that variety. You're as comfortable in front of a room of FAs as you are at a command line.

You will collaborate closely with engineering, product marketing, sales leadership, and the field. You welcome the freedom and opportunity of being part of a startup and have the self-discipline to identify needs and get things done without waiting to be asked. You will be encouraged to help shape the strategy that the MinIO team executes.

Previous experience in a field architect, solutions architect, or technical sales role is required — you need to understand how FAs think, what they need in a competitive engagement, and how to make training land in that context. Previous experience with competitive software-defined storage platforms is strongly preferred. Strong oral and written communication skills are essential.

What You Will Do

  • Design and deliver field architect curriculum — equipping FAs and Customer Engineers (CEs) with the technical depth and competitive positioning fluency needed to win enterprise deals
  • Deliver live and recorded enablement sessions for field architects and, occasionally, non-technical sales audiences
  • Develop partner sales curriculum by translating sales and marketing content into structured, teachable modules for partner and reseller audiences
  • Build core curriculum for customer administrators and operators — covering installation, configuration, management, and troubleshooting
  • Create use-case "wrappers" that reframe core curriculum content for specific deployment contexts and horizontal use cases, with references to vertical specifics where relevant
  • Build curriculum for AIStor Memory and agentic AI use cases, translating orchestration and memory concepts (context assembly, agent state, retrieval) into competitive, FA-ready training
  • Contribute to special projects requiring hands-on technical skill across a broad range of technologies including Linux, Ansible, Python, Kubernetes, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph, vector/memory stores)
  • Build real-world, use case–driven hands-on labs that establish best practices for deploying and operating MinIO products
  • Apply prior experience with competitive storage platforms to inform differentiated, insight-rich training content
  • Package labs and content into short, outcome-oriented training modules with videos
  • Record engaging videos of modules for MinIO Academy, YouTube, and LinkedIn

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years in a field architect, solutions architect, technical sales engineer, or equivalent customer-facing technical role
  • 3+ years of experience with software-defined storage including hands-on experience with MinIO, AWS S3, or competitive storage platforms (Vast, Cloudian, Weka)
  • 1+ years of experience with agentic AI infrastructure (e.g., agent memory/orchestration platforms such as LangChain/LangGraph, Mem0, Letta, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Memory Bank);
  • or memory/vector infrastructure (Pinecone, Weaviate, Redis) strongly preferred
  • 3+ years using Amazon AWS, including a solid understanding of S3 and the S3 API
  • 3+ years working in a Kubernetes environment
  • Working proficiency in Linux; comfortable with Ansible, Python, and related tooling
  • 1+ years building and maintaining workflows in git
  • Demonstrated comfort engaging field architects and sales teams — you genuinely enjoy it
  • Strong oral and written communication skills — in writing, in front of a camera, and live
  • Previous experience with curriculum development or formal training delivery is a plus, but is not required

What We Offer:

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • 401K with 3% Contribution
  • Pre-IPO Stock Options
  • At least 12 Public Holidays
  • Flexible Time Off
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

Estamos recebendo candidatos (as) para nosso banco de talentos!

O objetivo da área de Parcerias é criar um ecossistema de empresa que agregue valor a todos os envolvidos na cadeia, incluindo a BigDataCorp, nossos clientes, nossos parceiros, e os clientes desses parceiros. Entendemos que o nosso sucesso está diretamente relacionado à capacidade do mercado como um todo de fornecer uma ampla gama de dados diferenciados, a fim de facilitar a tomada de decisões mais assertivas e impulsionar o crescimento de negócios para todas as partes envolvidas, e que não conseguimos construir esse futuro sozinhos.

A Pessoa Executiva de Parcerias atuará como um elo entre a BigDataCorp e o mercado. Será responsável por atender potenciais parceiros, entender suas necessidades e oportunidades, avaliar e conduzí-los no processo de negociação da parceria.

Deve demonstrar excelentes habilidade de comunicação e negociação. Um olhar curioso e criativo sobre negócios que envolvam dados, proatividade na busca e atenção às necessidades dos parceiros são chave. Com o tempo, espera-se que contribua para um aumento das parcerias e mantenha um relacionamento próximo e construtivo com os parceiros da BigDataCorp.

O dia a dia

  • Identificar e atender potenciais parceiros
  • Conduzir processo de negociação de parcerias
  • Atuar como ponto focal de parceiros para temas comerciais
  • Conduzir internamente resolução de temas ligados à área
  • Garantir que processos da área sejam cumpridos
  • Atualizar parceiros sobre novos recursos e/ou produtos

  • Experiência prática com atendimento ao cliente
  • Conhecimento de software de CRM e Planilhas (Google Sheets/Excel)
  • Compreensão das métricas de desempenho de vendas
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidades de negociação
  • Habilidades organizacionais e de gerenciamento de tempo

raw.excerpt: About the Role We’re building high-quality ground-truth datasets used to train and validate perception models for autonomous and operator-assisted machines working in complex, real-world environments.
raw.description:
About the Role

We’re building high-quality ground-truth datasets used to train and validate perception models for autonomous and operator-assisted machines working in complex, real-world environments.

As a Data Annotation Analyst, you’ll work with camera imagery, video, and LiDAR point clouds to create precise labels that help perception systems understand objects, people, terrain, and surrounding environments. You’ll work in specialized annotation tools, following detailed specifications while balancing accuracy, consistency, and production volume.

Your Impact

  • Annotate 2D and 3D objects across images, video, and LiDAR point clouds, including vehicles, machinery, people, signage, and environmental features.
  • Create and maintain accurate segmentation, object tracking, pose, and keypoint annotations across sequences.
  • Apply detailed annotation guidelines, including class definitions, occlusion rules, object thresholds, and inclusion/exclusion criteria.
  • Review your work, respond to QA feedback, and maintain established quality and accuracy standards.
  • Identify and escalate ambiguous scenes, sensor artifacts, tooling issues, and gaps in specifications rather than making assumptions.
  • Document data quality and tooling issues with clear details and reproduction steps.
  • Participate in calibration sessions, guideline reviews, and team standups to maintain consistent interpretations.
  • Share observations that help improve annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and edge-case documentation.

Success in this role means producing accurate, consistent annotations at the expected volume while helping maintain a reliable, high-quality dataset.

What You Bring

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while performing repetitive, visually intensive work for extended periods.
  • Strong spatial reasoning skills, including the ability to interpret 3D environments and understand object size, position, and orientation.
  • Ability to learn and navigate complex, purpose-built software and become productive with keyboard shortcuts and other tooling features.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, scaled environment with defined productivity, quality, or accuracy targets.
  • Experience with image annotation GenAI workflows
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a distraction-free workspace, and the ability to work on a company-provisioned machine within a controlled environment.

Nice to Haves

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree.
  • Experience with image, video, LiDAR, or 3D annotation tools.
  • Experience with subsurface utility engineering (SUE), construction surveying, surveying, GIS, or other work involving spatial interpretation of physical environments.
  • Experience with AutoCAD or similar type tools
  • Experience in construction, mining, agriculture, industrial operations, or heavy equipment environments.
  • Familiarity with point cloud data, sensor fusion, or camera-LiDAR calibration.
  • Experience working with autonomous vehicles, robotics, or machine perception datasets.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest-quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You’ll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You’ll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre-training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

The Marketing Success Manager is the strategic partner and primary point of contact for our clients, owning both the relationship and the marketing outcomes that keep them with Ekwa long-term. Evolving from the traditional Client Success Manager role, this position blends account retention and relationship management with direct accountability for marketing performance and ROI.

Working with dental, medical, and other healthcare practice owners, the Marketing Success Manager ensures each client clearly understands the value Ekwa delivers, sees measurable results from their SEO, website, social media, and online advertising campaigns, and is confident in renewing and growing their partnership.   • Stay current on digital marketing trends and best practices relevant to the healthcare/dental sector.

Reporting & Communication

  • Communicate progress, wins, and next steps to clients in a way that is transparent and easy to understand.
  • Manage client expectations professionally, handling concerns with empathy and timely follow-through.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Act as the liaison between clients and Ekwa's specialist teams (SEO, web design, content, social media, advertising), ensuring deliverables align with client goals.
  • Brief internal teams on client objectives and feed back client priorities to keep work on track.
  • Collaborate with leadership on process improvements that raise the standard of client service and results.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

raw.description:
EOPA NATIONAL FELLOWSHIP
As a comprehensive career development and leadership opportunity, the National Fellowship Program is designed to harness and inspire the next generation of public leaders.

We are seeking highly motivated, dedicated, and passionate changemakers to assist with a variety of projects in the startup phase, including research, outreach, strategy, partnerships, fundraising, and communications. If you want to contribute to a high-leverage start-up campaign and make a national difference, this fellowship is for you.

10 fellows are accepted into the 5-month-long program beginning Jan 1st through May 31st

Core Fellowship Roles and Contributions

  • Contribute to high-leverage campaigns with national, state, and local policy impacts
  • Work with influential state and local elected leaders
  • Lead 1-3 projects in research, outreach, communications, policy, membership, partnerships, fundraising, or administration
  • Conduct phone or email outreach to elected officials, partners organizations
  • Participate in team meetings at least 1-2 times per week via video call
  • Support social media, video, and communications presence
  • Assist with designing and execution of membership development program

FELLOWSHIP DETAILS

  • Flexible hours: 20 to 40 hours per week, fellowship term 4-6+ months
  • Work is completely online/remote; flexible to accommodate academic schedule
  • $500-$750 stipends for fellowship period available for top applicants, commensurate with experience. (In order to accommodate the most fellows from underserved communities and with economic needs as possible, institutional funding will be used before EOPA funding for any selected fellows with institutional funding support.)
  • Expand your network and join our talented community of current fellows and alumni
  • Exclusive personalized training series from experienced lawmakers, civic service professionals, and the University of San Francisco Masters in Public Leadership
  • Gain valuable organizing and campaign, experience
  • Opportunities to advance in leadership as a Senior and Executive Fellow and staff
  • We are a dedicated and fun team who learn from each other

MAJOR PROJECTS
Elected Officials to Protect America state and national organizing - EOPA fellows learn and engage in state and national issue campaigns ranging from our federal National Climate Emergency Plan to state-based clean transportation initiatives.

We are seeking fellows with an interest in public policy, research, campaigns, running for office, working with lawmakers, organizing press conferences, and environmental organizing.

ProtectEarth.News Newsmagazine - Our independent newsmagazine fellows write and publish environmentally-focused articles, videos, and podcasts.

We are seeking fellows who are interested in expanding their writing skills to create media advisories, press releases, articles, op-eds, policy papers, and conduct research.

Code Blue Water Security Solutions film and multimedia production - Fellows learn how to produce short videos to educate lawmakers, the media, and the public.

We are seeking fellows who wish to expand or gain knowledge in video editing, cinematography, audio, writing scripts, the production process, support our podcast, and updating websites.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Passion and experience in environment, energy, civic engagement, and/or public policy issues;
  • Solid problem-solving skills;
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills;
  • Ability to work remotely, efficiently, and reliably meet deadlines; arrange your schedule and hours;
  • Zest, grit, hope, love, social intelligence, gratitude, and a sense of humor;
  • Proficiency with Google Docs and Sheets;
  • Experience in organizing, campaigns, or policy is an asset.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Elected Officials to Protect America's mission is to create a safe, prosperous, and healthy planet, we empower leadership from elected officials and civic leaders to protect our environment and fight the climate crisis. The nation's leader, in organizing veterans who are lawmakers and frontline leaders on the intersection of the environment and human society, our programs focus on collective solutions.

Our programs support solutions and policy development at the local, state, and federal levels.

EOPA educates lawmakers through training, collaborative exchange of ideas, and public engagement through value-based communication. Our network connects elected officials to create high-impact and systemic change through bold and consistent leadership to implement policies that

- Foster and promote policies that combat climate change, advance the transitions to clean energy systems that strengthen our economic resiliency, and enhance national security.

- Protect and conserve public lands and waterways — enhancing environmental protection to prevent and eliminate destructive practices, protect watersheds and keep the land vibrant for future generations.

- Fight environmental and racial injustice for all peoples through training and hands-on experience that enhances the development of public leaders to serve the communities most impacted by the climate crisis.

We embrace problem solvers and owners who aren't afraid to experiment and fail, and are ready to create something new.

  • You will have the opportunity to work in a highly innovative and state-of-the-art environment and transform the way people communicate and tell stories;
  • We are at a sufficiently early-stage level that you can meaningfully contribute, but at a nicely established situation, where our largest chances to fail are behind us.

You will be responsible for overseeing product’s feature development cycles, making sure the communication between cross-functional areas is flowing optimally, managing the production process by working with internal and external teams across all disciplines, following roadmaps, schedules, and milestones, reporting, and having the support of the Studio Executive Producer. Your day-to-day routine will be working along with Creative Directors, Core, and Support Teams planning, prioritizing, and following deliveries, always having your attention on quality and deadlines and balancing efficiency and sustainability. To do so, you’ll need to speak the language of aesthetics to designers, code to programmers, and results to stakeholders, helping to resolve interpersonal communication issues in a short development cycle.

Main Cross-Functional Activities:

  • Lead and prepare meetings making sure all relevant stakeholders are in place.

  • Own the production organization tools, making sure they are used and serve their purpose within the company’s workflow, practices, and culture.
  • Together with the Studio Executive Producer allocate production resources, balancing scope and capacity, managing budgets, and raising flags when they’re at risk.
  • If external team members are needed or requested you will be responsible for procurement and onboarding, assigning tasks, and creating schedules that include deadlines and integration among teams, keeping track of external teams' deliveries.

Must Have:

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact with team members of different disciplines.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of independence.
  • Strong problem-solving and prioritization skills, both for your own work and for the team.
  • A keen eye for detail.

  • Good level of emotional intelligence and conflict resolution.
  • Ability and sensitivity to identify problems and risks, communicating immediately with stakeholders to articulate solutions.
  • Positive, flexible, and "get-it-done" attitude while managing big-picture changes.
  • Constantly looking for self-improvement, learning new skills and delivering the highest quality output.
  • Always giving and receiving constructive and creative feedback.
  • Previous experience in waterfall methodology and knowledge of agile frameworks.

Nice to Have:

  • Have worked as a game producer in at least one high profile Video Game that has been shipped.
  • Understanding of software development life cycles.
  • Be familiar with Google G Suite,Jira, Slack and Github.
  • Previous knowledge or experience with VR and AR content is desirable.

raw.title: Clinical Operations Specialist
raw.excerpt: Our MissionHealthie is an AI-Native, ONC Certified EHR for modern outpatient healthcare.
raw.description:
Our Mission

Healthie is an AI-Native, ONC Certified EHR for modern outpatient healthcare.

Healthie is proud to power clinically excellent healthcare for over 40,000 providers who deliver clinically excellent healthcare - longitudinal and collaboratively, with patient and provider experiences at the center. Both healthcare and technology are undergoing unparalleled industry innovation, and it’s incredible to see the momentum - from consumers, from providers, and from reimbursement for this type of healthcare - grow exponentially.

We provide the powerful infrastructure every care delivery organization needs. On the surface this includes EHR, Scheduling, Engagement, Billing, Data, and much more. Underneath the iceberg are thousands of configurations, settings, widgets, automations, and limitless capabilities because we are an API-first platform. Our fully brandable platform makes it easy for clinics and organizations of any size to scale and never reach a limit.

Today, over 3 billion API calls are made to Healthie every month, as thousands of organizations who work with more than 21 million patients in total, rely on Healthie to deliver clinically excellent healthcare in over 35 specialties, from behavioral healthcare to complex chronic care management and personalized medicine.

We believe in the power of technology to improve access to healthcare and we’re building the rails that make this a reality. We work fast and with quality because we provide business-critical, healthcare-critical software that clinicians and patients need for a better healthcare system. We’re customer-obsessed, operate with lightning-fast processes and responses, and always share our product roadmap publicly- so customers can see what we’re building, and remain relentlessly focused on how care gets delivered.

Healthie is backed by leading investors, and while we've $42M raised to date, more importantly, we operate with fiscal responsibility and have been profitable for more than half of our time as a company. We know that building an ONC-Certified EHR is a lifetime’s body of work, and we are here to build for our customers forever.

Learn more at

About the role

We’re hiring a Clinical Operations Specialist to help us deliver a best-in-class product for innovative healthcare delivery. This is a critical role in serving customers who use our most important clinical solutions. The right person for the job excels at a wide range of operational functions—like a swiss army knife that can answer customer questions, troubleshoot complex issues, or write process documentation.

We won’t overburden you with quotas, empty policies, or unnecessary procedures. Doing what’s in the best interest of our customers is at the heart of what we do. We’ll give you plenty of support to simply do what’s right, no questions asked.

Our ideal hire is motivated by healthcare technology and what we’re doing as a company, believes in the value of great customer experience, and is eager to contribute to the everyday success of our customers as they deliver care to millions of patients around the country.

At Healthie, we are AI-enabled and AI-accelerated in how we build. We are looking for team members who actively leverage AI-powered development tools, embrace automation, and help teams adopt modern, AI-assisted engineering practices to increase velocity and quality.

About the work

  • You’ll manage the implementation processes, onboarding tasks, and ongoing support for customers who are integrating with our clinical technology partners: from E-Rx, E-labs and ClaimMD enablements, to insurance billing and ordering labs, to troubleshooting errors with prescriptions or lab results, to identity verification and customization options—you’ll know all there is to know about Healthie’s clinical integrations.
  • You'll serve as first-line technical support for customers using our clinical integrations, responding quickly and accurately throughout the day. Because these integrations directly affect patient care, the work we do requires a true sense of urgency.
  • Most of the work happens over email in Help Scout, but you’ll also lead calls as needed with customers and/or vendors to identify, escalate, and solve problems. You’ll also hop on Zoom to screen share and help troubleshoot a technical or onboarding problem for providers who are getting ramped-up with E-Rx.
  • You’ll work closely with our ClinOps Program Manager to write new processes, policies, and documentation to help educate our team and our customers on all things related to clinical integrations.
  • Our clinical integrations are a mission-critical part of our product. You’ll build strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to provide valuable product feedback and customer insights. When you notice patterns in customer feedback, you’ll advocate internally to improve our product as well as the customer experience.

About you

  • You’ve done this kind of work before. We’re looking for someone who has 5-8 years of hands-on implementation and customer support experience. It is required that you have worked at a software-as-a-service company. Bonus points if you’ve worked at a healthcare technology company.
  • You’d consider yourself a full-spectrum generalist with a strong foundational understanding of things like: single sign-on and 2FA, billing and invoicing, modern browsers and mobile operating systems, help desk portals, email deliverability, reading log files of any kind. Overall, you’re more technical than most customer-facing professionals.
  • You’re great at collaborating and communicating with both technical and non-technical teammates, vendors, and customers. You’ll be working with healthcare experts, care navigators, physicians, third-party support teams, and executives—you’re someone who always finds the right tone.
  • You are detail-oriented, organized, and great at context-switching. You diligently track product updates, follow up on outstanding items, and proactively communicate status changes to customers. You'd thrive working independently on a small, nimble team that doesn’t have a lot of structure.
  • You aren’t afraid to take action and make changes. When you see something that could be improved, whether it’s refining a saved reply to better inform a customer or restructuring an entire workflow, you speak up and advocate for change.
  • You must be an excellent writer. You’re someone who can take complex subjects and break them down using clear and simple language. Your writing skills are critical to your success at Healthie.
  • When you don’t know something, you try to figure it out. You use the resources available to you, ask good questions, and embrace the chance to grow and get better. You are a great problem-solver with the ability to understand and resolve issues quickly.
  • You’re well-versed in the tools of the trade. We use Help Scout, Stripe, Sendgrid, Slack, Zoom, GSuite, Mixpanel, and Basecamp to help serve our customers.
  • This isn’t a stepping stone to another team at Healthie. You want to be part of our clinical support team for a while, and you’re excited to continue to sharpen your skills in a customer-facing position. You’ll have lots of opportunities to grow, learn, and raise your skill set along the way.

Details, details

  • This is a full-time, remote position and U.S. work authorization is required.
  • This job is Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm EST.
  • We’re seeking fluent English speakers/writers.
  • The salary for this position is a base between $85,000 - $102,500.

Note about holiday support: We provide support coverage on all holidays, and you'll be required to work a few shifts throughout the year. We have a simple and human process for signing up for holiday coverage. And however many hours you work on a holiday, you can take that time off another day.

Interview Plan

  • Quick chat with Talent team (15 minutes)
  • Chat with Bailey, ClinOps Team Lead and hiring manager (30 minutes)
  • Interview with Kelli, ClinOps Program Manager (30 minutes)
  • Talk with Justin, VP of Customer Support (30 minutes)
  • Meet your teammates Nick and Sarah, ClinOps Specialists (30 minutes)
  • Final session with Bailey and Justin (30 minutes)
  • Reference Checks

Healthie is subject to HIPAA and other security and privacy frameworks, and this job entails training and conformance to expectations regarding security and compliance.

Healthie participates in e-verify.

Healthie is committed to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, color,religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category. We're proud to be building a diverse and inclusive environment that encourages collaboration, creativity, and growth. Whatever your background, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

raw.description:
Responsibilities

● Program Design and Delivery (50%)

  • Contribute to and facilitate the implementation of the long-term strategy for building out citiesRISE’s Accelerator and Learning Platform for different constituents (primarily social innovators, cities, youth) towards paradigm shifts in youth mental health
  • Conduct and synthesize results from needs assessments for different constituents to inform program design
  • Partner with citiesRISE’s research and innovation hubs to set up Accelerator support to work with a targeted set of social innovations in priority cities to support the advancement of the Mental Health Friendly Cities (MHFC) framework
  • Facilitate the design of platform offerings and infrastructure to support the creation of the Accelerator support to be distinct from the Learning Platform support, and in alignment with the needs of the constituents as well as citiesRISE’s broader strategy and goals
  • Coordinate logistics and undertake project planning and resourcing for various aspects of platform operations, including overseeing delivery by a team of citiesRISE staff and project teams, external faculty, and other partners in delivery
  • For select areas (e.g., meaningful youth engagement, cross-boundary/transdisciplinary partnerships, path-to-market/scale, monitoring, evaluation, and learning) directly lead on the development and delivery of offerings (as opposed to just coordinating)
  • Coordinate platform evaluation efforts and the use of evaluation data to improve programming
  • Ensure timely and accurate financial monitoring and reporting

● Partnerships and Innovative Financing (25%)

  • Manage relationships with a growing roster of innovators, faculty and other partners involved in delivering services via the platform
  • Manage relationships and ensure timely and high-quality delivery with multiple funders supporting the platform
  • Support the development and implementation of a longer-term business model to ensure long-term growth and sustainability of the platform
  • Support the mobilization of new types of financing mechanisms for the Accelerator and support the development of the MHFC Fund
  • Support the cultivation of strategic relationships with current and new anchor partners and funders to grow the platform

● Field Building (25%)

  • Coordinate marketing activities to raise awareness in the field about the work of the platform and how the platform is helping drive paradigm shifts in youth mental health
  • Identify and work to strengthen additional ways for the platform to support citiesRISE’s other areas of work, e.g., on-the-ground R&D work in city research and innovation hubs, youth-led campaigns in support of the global movement of Mental Health Friendly Cities
  • Develop a learning agenda for the work of the platform and coordinate the production of a range of learning products such as reports, briefs, and workshops
  • Experience scaling innovations in global health or related areas across multiple countries
  • Experience and knowledge in one or more of the following areas: global mental health; youth programming; youth leadership development; social innovation; innovative financing
  • Experience working to develop accelerator and/or learning platform programs for social innovators and/or other stakeholders, or analogous experience
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders to develop shared goals and ability to steward collaborative work that requires the ability to cut across sectors and cultures
  • Program and project management experience, managing multiple work streams that contribute to long-term objectives
  • Experience supporting senior leaders to address challenges, particularly through designing and delivering convenings or workshop offerings
  • Working in a team, having distinct roles and responsibilities and contributing to a broader objective
  • Managing multiple deadlines and activities simultaneously
  • Working within a global, virtual team environment across time zones
  • Strong synthesis skills and exceptional communication - written and verbal
  • Financial monitoring and reporting experience (preferred but not required)
  • Experience commissioning other organizations and managing contracts with suppliers (preferred
  • but not required)
  • Facilitation skills, e.g., workshops, convenings (preferred but not required)
  • Spanish or French fluency would be a plus

This is a fully remote position with a preference for candidates located in the Global South.

citiesRISE is an equal opportunity employer and champions diversity on its team and in its movement. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

About citiesRISE

citiesRISE was founded in 2017 in response to the need to not only increase access to mental health support, but also drive fundamental paradigm shifts in how mental health is conceptualized and addressed. citiesRISE is a collaborative platform rooted in diverse local city research and innovation hubs in Bogotá, Chennai, Nairobi, Sacramento and Seattle, with global reach through an Accelerator and Learning Platform and movement of Mental Health Friendly Cities (MHFC). The approach enables highly contextualized local work linked via a global network and results framework.

citiesRISE’s vision is to improve mental health and well-being for millions of young people in their different developmental stages and ecological settings. Its mission is to transform mental health globally through local social innovation, coalition building, and youth-driven action. Alongside improving the lives of millions of young people, citiesRISE aims to drive a shift: from clinical care alone to integration with promotion and prevention of wellbeing; from mental health siloed in the health sector to intersectional and mainstreamed across sectors; from expert-driven interventions to embracing non-traditional actors; from youth as beneficiaries to youth at the center of transformation; and, from communities as passive entities (recipients) to communities being the places of transformation and driving change. The citiesRISE platform accelerates and influences innovations in global mental health and challenges cities to become more mental health friendly.

Learn more at cities-rise.org
